sa: निवर्तयामास ततः सर्षिसङ्घः स पक्षिणः। ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं लम्बमाने दिवाकरे॥ वासं चक्रुर्मुनिगणाः शोणाकूले समाहिताः। तेऽस्तं गते दिनकरे स्नात्वा हुतहुताशनाः॥ विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य निषेदुरमितौजसः। रामोऽपि सहसौमित्रिर्मुनीस्तानभिपूज्य च॥ जग्रतो निषसादाथ विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः।
en: Having proceeded a long way, when the sun was sioping down, the ascetics rested on the banks of the Soņa. And when the maker of day had set, having bathed and offered oblations to the fire those ascetics of immeasurable energy, placing Viśvāmitra in their front, sat them down. And Rāma also together with Sumitrā's son, having paid homage to those ascetics, sat him down before the intelligent Viśvāmitra.

sa: स योगबलमास्थाय विवेश नृपतेस्तनुम्। विदुरो धर्मराजस्य तेजसा प्रज्वलन्निव॥
en: Indeed, with the help of Yoga-power, Vidura, burning with energy, thus entered the body of king Yudhishthira the just.

sa: मृत्युरुवाच या काचिदेव चेष्टा स्यात् सर्वा कालप्रचोदिता। पूर्वमेवैतदुक्तं हि मया लुब्धक कालतः॥ तस्मादुभौ कालवशावावां निर्दिष्टकारिणौ। नावां दोषेण गन्तव्यौ त्वया लुब्धक कर्हिचित्॥
en: Mrityu said Everything is done under the influence of Kala. I have said it before, O fowler, that Kala is the cause of all and therefore we both, acting under the influence of Kala, do our appointed work and, therefore, O fowler, we two should not be blamed by you.

sa: श्वोभूतेऽथ ततः शौरिर्वसुदेवः प्रतापवान। युक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं महातेजा जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: When morning dawned, Vasudeva of great energy and prowess attained, through the help of Yoga, to the highest end.

sa: अर्हसे च कपिश्रेष्ठ मया समभिभाषितुम्। यद्यसि प्रेषितस्तेन रामेण विदितात्मना॥ प्रेषयिष्यति दुर्धर्षो रामो नह्यपरीक्षितम्। पराक्रममविज्ञाय मत्सकाशं विशेषतः॥
en: O best of monkeys, you are worthy of my welcome, since you had been despatched by Rāma, knowing self, Rāma, hard of being got at, has not sent you, specially to me, without a trial of your prowess.

sa: तथा विविधवृत्तानामपि सम्भव उच्यते। यतते योगमास्थाय मित्रामित्रं विचारयेत्॥
en: The very existence of restless persons is dangerous. Kings should, therefore, with minute attention, determine their friends, and enemies.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽथ देवेन्द्रः पुरी रावणपालिताम्। आगच्छन्निद्रया सार्ध भगवान् पाकशासनः॥
en: Thus addressed by the reverend chastiser of Pāka, Devendra in company with sleep, approached the city ruled by Rāvana.

sa: अलम्बुषस्तु समरे भीमसेनं महाबलम्। योधयामास संक्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणं रावणिर्यथा॥
en: Alambusha filled with rage, fought on with the highly powerful Bhimasena, like the son of Ravana fighting with Lakshmana.

sa: अथैवमुक्ते वचने प्रोवाचेदमकम्पनः। शृणु राजन् यथावृत्तं रामस्य बलपौरुषम्॥
en: When he had said this, Akampana said, He ar, O king, the true report of Rāma's prowess and manliness.

sa: सुहृद्भिस्तत्र रामोऽपि सहासीनः प्रियंवदैः। सभाजितो विवेशाथ ताननुज्ञाप्य सर्वशः॥
en: Rāma, having passed some time with sweetspeeched friends, and been honoured by them, with their permission entered his apartment.

sa: स भीमं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः भैमान् परिजघानाशु रथास्त्रिशतमाहवे॥
en: That Rakshasa then piercing Bhima with five arrows of depressed knots, quickly slew three hundred car-warriors engaged supporting Bhima.

sa: न शक्याः पाण्डवा जेतुं सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः। तस्माद् युद्धे स्थिरां कृत्वा मतिं युद्ध्यस्व भारत॥
en: The sons of Pandu cannot be vanquished even by the celestial headed by Indra himself. Therefore, o Bharata, forming a firm determination for fight, do you fight on (with the Pandavas).

sa: तत्र ह्यगस्त्यः पादेन वहन् स्पृष्टो मया मुनिः। अगस्तयेन ततोऽस्म्युक्तः सर्पस्त्वं च भवेति ह॥
en: One day when the sage Agastya was drawing my palanquin my feet touched his body. Thereupon Agastya cursed me in anger saying "ruin overtake you; do you turn into a snake."

sa: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच मानसेनेह धर्मेण संयुक्ताः पुरुषाः सदा। स्वर्गं गच्छन्ति कल्याणि तन्मे कीर्तयतः शृणु॥
en: Maheshvara said Gifted with merit that originates from mental acts, O goddess, one ascends to Heaven. Listen to me, O auspicious one, as I recite to you what those acts are.

sa: नवद्वारं पुरं गत्वा हंसो हि नियतो वशी। ईशः सर्वस्य भूतस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च॥
en: Though the master of all existent beings both mobile and immobile, though inactive and shorn of attributes, it enters nevertheless the well-known house of nine doors and becomes engaged in action.

sa: सा विशीर्णा शरैर्भिन्ना पपात धरणीतले। गदा मन्त्रौषधिबलैालीव विनिपातिता॥
en: Thereupon, like a she-serpent brought down by force of incantations, the mace fell to the earth shattered and riven.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य ततोऽस्त्राणि प्रहृष्टवदनः शुचिः। गच्छन्नेव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having accepted those weapons with purity, Käkutstha while proceeding, with a complacent countenance spoke these words to sage Visvāmitra,-

sa: भेदं च प्रथमं युज्यात् तूष्णीं दण्डं तथैव च। काले प्रयोजयेद् राजा तस्मिंस्तस्मिंस्तदा तदा॥
en: The king should first use the means of creating disunion, as also those of conciliation. When the time for each particular means arrives, that particular expedient should be made use of.

sa: विदुर उवाच मैवं वदस्व कल्याणि शेषसंरक्षणं कुरु। प्रत्यादिष्टो हि दुष्टात्मा शेषेऽपि प्रहरेत् तव॥
en: Vidura said : O blessed lady, do not say so. Protect the others (your sons) from the Kurus. It abused, the wicked minded (Duryodhana) may kill the rest (of your sons).

sa: स भूयस्त्वं समुत्साहचोदितो हरिसत्तम। अस्मिन् कार्यसमुत्साहे प्रचिन्तय यदुत्तरम्॥
en: Do you bethink you as to what you will do afterwards, when you had been entrusted with this task.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा व्यथिता जस्ता वरं कृष्णमयाचत। दद व मे वरं कृष्ण भयार्ताया महाभुज॥
en: Seeing this, the queen became alarmed and aggrieved, she begged Krishna to grant her a boon. (She said), O mighty armed hero, I am afflicted with fear; grant me a boon.

sa: न चेद् वाञ्छसि त्वं युद्धद्यूतं प्रवर्तताम्। द्वैरथेनास्तु वै शान्तिस्तव वा मम वा नृप॥
en: If you do not like the game at dice, do you then engage yourself in the play at weapons. Really, O king, let us have peace by fighting out a duel.

sa: ततः कलकिलाशब्दैराकाशं पूरयन्निव। तेन शब्देन महता त्रस्तास्तत्र दिवौकसः॥
en: They filled the sky with their confused cries and shrieks. That noise filled the dwellers of heaven with fear.

sa: तमद्य वालिनं पश्य तीक्ष्णैराशीविषोपमैः॥ शरैर्विनिहतं भूमौ प्रकीर्णमिव पर्वतम्।
en: Do you today behold Vāli slain with sharpened shafts, resembling snakes,—like to a torn hill lying on the ground.

sa: यथा च स महाबाहुर्ले तारयति राघवः। अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि॥
en: And it behove you to strive so that the mighty-armed Rāghava may rescues me from this sea of sorrow.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरेणैवमुक्तो मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः। धौन्धुमारमुपाख्यानं कथयामास भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having been thus addressed by Yudhishthira, the great Rishi Markandeya narrated the story of Dhundhumara.

sa: भूमिः पञ्चगुणा ब्रह्मन्नुदकं च चतुर्गुणम्। गुणास्त्रयस्तेजसि च त्रयश्चाकाशवातयोः॥
en: O Brahmana, the earth has five qualities, water four, fire three and the air and the sky together three.

sa: तदद्भुतमभिप्रेक्ष्य द्वारकावासिनो जनाः। तूर्णात् तूर्णतरं जग्मुरहो दैवमिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Seeing this wonderful spectacle, the inhabitants of Dwraka walked faster and faster, saying. Wonderful is the course of fate.'

sa: नित्यमुत्साहयुक्तस्य वाचः श्रुत्वा मयेरिताः। वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये॥
en: Ever breathing high spirits, Dasarathi, (Dasaratha's son) hearing my words, shall attain an access of manliness for my deliverance.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन रावणेन स शंकरः। ददौ खङ्गं महादीप्तं चन्द्रहासमिति श्रुतम्। आयुषश्चावशषं च ददौ भूतपतिस्तदा॥
en: Thus addressed by him, (Ravana,) Sankara gave him an exceedingly effulgent sword, famed as Candrahāsa; and the master of spectres then also granted him peace for the rest of his life.

sa: मत्संदेशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तः श्रुत्वैव राघवः। पराक्रमे मतिं वीरो विधिवत्संविधास्यति॥
en: Soon as Rāghava shall hear words couching tidings of me, that hero shall duly resolve on displaying his prowess.

sa: धृतं माल्यं च गन्धांश्च क्षौमाणि च युधिष्ठिरः। चन्दानागुरुमुख्यानि तथा कालीयकान्यपि॥ प्रस्थाप्य पूर्वं कौन्तेयो भीष्मसंस्करणाय वै। माल्यानि च वराहा॑णि रतानि विविधानि च॥
en: Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, took with bin a large quantity of clarified butter and floral garlands and scents and silken cloths and excellent sandal wood and Aquilaria Agallocha and dark cloewood, for cremating the body of Bhishma. Various kinds of rich garlands and gems also were among those stores.

sa: वृषपर्वोवाच यत् किंचिदसुरेन्द्राणां विद्यते वसु भार्गव। भुवि हस्तिगवाश्वं च तस्य त्वं मम चेश्वरः॥
en: Vrishaparva said : O son of Bhrigu, you are the absolute master of everything that belongs to the Asura chief in this world these elephants, kine and horses, nay even myself.

sa: त्वं हि तं नारदश्चैव मुनयश्च सनातनम्॥ गोविन्दमनघं देवमभिजानीध्वमच्युतम्।
en: Yourself, Narada, and the Munis, knew him to be the eternal and sinless Govinda, the Deity of unfading glory.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा भरतः श्रीमान्शोकमोहपरिप्लुतः। अभ्यधावत धर्मात्मा भरतः केकयीसुतः॥
en: And seeing him, overwhelmed with grief and affliction, the righteous and graceful son of Kaikeyi, Bharata, rushed (towards him).

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छुत्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठः स राजा जनमेजयः। विस्मितोऽभवदत्यर्थं यज्ञकर्मान्तरेष्वथ।॥
en: Hearing this, O foremost of twice-born ones, at the intervals of sacrificial rites, king Janamejaya became filled with wonder.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति मां राजन् कष्टा हृदयशोषणः। आधयोऽभिभविष्यन्ति त्वामृते पुष्करेक्षण॥
en: O king, O lotus eyed, from this day the heart sucking affliction will always overwhelm me for your death.

sa: ते वध्यमाना भीष्मेण पञ्चाला: भीष्ममेवाभ्ययुस्तूर्णं त्यक्त्वा मृत्युकृतं भयम्॥
en: Through thus slaughtered by Bhishma, the Panchalas with the Somakas impetuously rushed against Bhishma, abandoning all fear of death.

sa: दशग्रीवोऽभयं तस्मै प्रददौ रक्षसां वरः। स विस्रब्धोऽब्रवीद् वाक्यमसंदिग्धमकम्पनः॥
en: Thereat that foremost of Raksasas, the tennecked one, granted him courage. Then inspired with confidence, Akampana without fear spoke,

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्यास्तत्रैवाधाय दारकान्। हताहमिति विक्रुश्य सहसैवाजगाम सा॥
en: Having heard her these words, Kunti bade the children to remain there came running and crying, "Woe to me!"

sa: षट्त्रिंशद् योजनायामा त्रिंशद् योजनमायता। पश्चात् पुस्चतुर्विशद् वेदी ह्यासीद्धिरण्मयी॥ गयस्य यजमानस्य मुक्तावज्रमणिस्तृता। प्रादात् स ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽथ वासांस्याभरणानि च॥
en: The sacrificial altar of Gaya was thirty yojanas long, twenty-six yojanas high; and it was covered with gold and strewn over with pearls and gems. He gave away this altar and inany garments and ornaments to the Brahmanas.

sa: जानाति हि मतं तेषामतस्त्रासयतीह नः। अर्जुने चास्य सम्प्रीतिमधिकामुपलक्षये।॥
en: He knows their views and strikes terror into our minds. I perceive his affection for Arjuna is very great.

sa: कामं च ते करिष्यामि यन्मां वक्ष्यसि बाहुक। विदर्भान् यदि यात्वाद्य सूर्यं दर्शयितासि मे॥
en: O Bahuka, I shall fulfill your desire, (that is, whatever you will tell me) if you take me today to the country of the Vidharbhas and make me see the sun-rise."

sa: । नारद उवाच गयं चामूर्तरयसं मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम। यो वै वर्षशतं राजा हुतशिष्टाशनोऽभवत्॥
en: Narada said O Srinjaya, we also heard of the death of king Gaya, the son of Amurtarajas, who for hundred years lived only upon remnants of the libations offered on fire.

sa: ते ह्यनपराधी स दुष्टान्तरात्मना। पञ्चत्वमगमद्राजा वजाहत इव दुमः॥
en: Who was unoffending, but who died like a tree stricken by thunder, having been bitten by this vile serpent.

sa: एष शैलशिलाभिस्तु पूरयित्वा महार्णवम्। द्वारमाश्रित्य लङ्काया रामस्तिष्ठति सायुधः।।११
en: Having filled up the deep with rocks and crags, Rāma equipped with weapons, stay, occupying the gate of Lanka.

sa: युधिष्ठिरमथायान्तं शारद्वतरथं प्रति। सपुत्रं सहसैन्यं च द्रौणपुत्रो न्यवारयत्॥
en: Drona's son then resisted Yudhishthira who was advancing with his own son and arms against the son of Sharadvata.

sa: विनद्य सुमहानादं श्रमेणोपरताः स्त्रियः। निर्घोषोपरतं तात मन्ये राजनिवेशनम्॥
en: Having bewailed aloud, the women have, methinks, (by this time) ceased through fatigue, and the king's residence is still.

sa: पुलस्त्य उवाच एवमुक्तः स राजेन्द्र रामः प्रहरतां वरः। अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं पितॄन् स गगने स्थितान्॥ भवन्तो यदि मे प्रीता यद्यनुचाह्यता मयि। पितृप्रसादमिच्छेयं तप आप्यायनं पुनः॥
en: Pulastya said : O king, having been thus addressed, that foremost of smiters, Rama, thus spoke with joined hands to the Pitris who were in the sky. If you are pleased with me and if I have deserved your favour, I desire to get this favour from the Pitris that I may again derive pleasure in asceticism.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तद् धर्मराजस्य वचो निशम्य धर्मस्वरूपो भगवानुवाचा युधिष्ठिरं प्रीतियुक्तो नरेन्द्र श्लक्ष्णैर्वाक्यैः संस्तवसम्प्रयुक्तैः॥
en: Hearing these words of king Yudhishthira the just, (the dog became transformed into) the deity of Virtue, who well pleased, said words to him in a sweet voice fraught with praise,

sa: अप्रसन्नमनाः किं नु सदा मां प्रति वत्सलः। विषण्णवदनो दीनः नहि मां प्रति भाषते॥
en: Why is his mind so aggrieved who was so kind to me, and why does he look poorly and of pale countenance who used to welcome me always with kind words?

sa: वयमक्षाः सुदुर्बुद्धे तव वासो जिहीर्षवः। आगता न हि नः प्रीतिः सवाससि गते त्वयि॥
en: 'O greatly foolish one! we are even those dice. We had come hither desirous of robbing your cloth. For surely we feel no pleasure, even if you depart wearing your cloth.'

sa: अथ काले तु कस्मिंश्चिद्राजा भार्गवमाश्रमम्। रमणीयमुपाक्रामच्चैत्रे मासि मनोरमे॥
en: Thereupon during spring, in the month of Caitra the king arrived at the picturesque hermitage of the preceptor Sukra.

sa: कालाम्ररसपीतास्ते नित्यं संस्थितयौवनाः॥ दक्षिणेन तु नीलस्य निषधस्योत्तरेण तु।
en: They remain young for ever by drinking the juice of the Kalamra tree. On the north of the Nishadha.

sa: अथ राजा विदेहानां ददौ कन्याधनं बहु। गवां शतसहस्राणि बहूनि मिथिलेश्वरः॥ कम्बलानां च मुख्यानां क्षौमान् कोट्यम्बराणि च। हस्त्यश्वरथपादातं दिव्यरूपं स्वलंकृतम्॥ ददौ कन्याशतं तासां दासीदासमनुत्तमम्। हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य मुक्तानां विद्रुमस्य च ॥
en: Then the king of the Videhas gave a dower consisting of various things. And Mithilā's lord gave many hundred thousands of kine, and excellent woollen stuffs, and Koțis of common cloths; and elephants, and horses, and cars, and footmen, as well as an hundred damsels adorned, endowed with elegance to form goodly waitingmaids. And well-pleased the king gave as a noble dower gold and silver and pearls and coral.

sa: स राहोर्वचनं श्रुत्वा वासवः संभ्रमान्वितः। उत्पपातासनं हित्वा उद्वहन्काञ्चनीं जम्॥ ततः कैलासकूटाभं चतुर्दन्तं मदस्रवम्। शृङ्गारधारिणं प्रांशुं स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम्॥ इन्द्रः करीन्द्रमारुह्य राहुं कृत्वा पुरःसरम्। प्रायाद्यवाभवत्सूर्यः सहानेन हनूमता॥
en: Hearing the words of Råhu, the King of the deities, wearing a golden garland, having his understanding bewildered, proceeded, on the back of his elephant-chief Airavata, huge like the summit of the Kailäsa hill, with temporal juice always trickling, having four tasks, roaring, and adorned with golden bells, towards Hanumān and the sun with Rāhu before him.

sa: अनुक्तोऽप्यत्रभवता भवत्या वचनादहम्। वने वत्स्यामि विजने वर्षाणीह चतुर्दश॥
en: Even though not commanded by him, I shall, for your words, live in a solitary forest for fourteen years.

sa: राक्षसानां सहस्रैश्च वृतः परमदुर्जयः। गृहेभ्यः पुष्पवर्षेण कीर्यमाणस्तदा ययौ॥
en: That exceedingly unconquerable one, surrounded by thousands of Raksasas, went on, showered with blossoms from the houses (standing by).

sa: नमस्कृत्वाथ रामाय लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान्। सीतादर्शनसंहष्टो हनुमान् संवृतोऽभवत्॥
en: Having offered his obeisance to Räma and Lakşmaņa the powerful Hanumān, greatly delighted in seeing Sītā, remained there hidden.

sa: तां स दीर्घतमाङ्गेषु स्पृष्ट्वा देवीमथाब्रवीत्। भविष्यन्ति कुमारास्ते तेजसादित्यवर्चसः॥
en: Dhirghatama touched that lady's body and told her, “You will give birth to sons, as effulgent as the sun.

sa: प्रहस्तं तं हि निर्यान्तं प्रख्यातगुणपौरुषम्।। युधि नानाप्रहरणा कपिसेनाभ्यवर्तत॥
en: And as Prahasta of renowned worth and valour marched, the monkey-army equipped with various arms, presented themselves before him.

sa: भ्राता मे क्वावसद् रात्रौ क्व सीता क्व च लक्ष्मणः। अस्वपच्छयने कस्मिन् किं भुक्त्वा गुह शंस मे॥
en: Where did my brother pass the night? And where did Sītā? And where did, again, Laks maņa? And in what bed did he sleep, and what did he previously partake of? Do you, O Guha, tell me this.

sa: अनेन हि सहायेन कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। इष्टान् सर्वानभिप्रायान् प्राप्स्याम: सर्वराजसु॥
en: By the help of namely of Krishna of unblamable acts, we, of all other kings, shall obtain all desirable

sa: अथाब्रवीत् केशवः संनिवर्त्य शब्दं श्रुत्वा योषितां क्रोशतीनाम्॥ पुरीमिमामेष्यति सव्यसाची स वो दुःखान्मोचयिता नराग्र्यः।
en: Hearing that loud sound of wailing uttered by the weeping ladies, Keshava returned and said to them, Arjuna will come here. That foremost of men will relieve you of your sorrow.

sa: एवं स वसुधाराभिर्वर्षमाणो नृपाम्बुदः। तर्पयामास विप्रांस्तान् वर्षन् सस्यमिवाम्बुद॥
en: Like the clouds refreshing the crops with their downpours, that royal cloud pleased the Brahinanas by downpours of riches.

sa: स दीन इव शोका” विषण्णवदनद्युतिः। कैकेयीमभिवाद्यैव रामो वचनमब्रवीत्।॥
en: Being pressed with sorrow, Rāma of pale countenance, like one miserable, saluting KaikeyI, spoke to her the following words.

sa: हीयमानमथापश्यत् सुग्रीवं वानरेश्वरम्। प्रेक्षमाणं दिशश्चैव राघवः स मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Rāghava again and again beheld the weak points of that monkey chief Sugrīva, losing his strength by and by.

sa: ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे भार्गवस्यानुयायिनः। प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त परिवार्य रणाजिरम्॥
en: Then did all the devotees, the followers of the scion of Bhrigu's race, become the spectators and surround us.

sa: चिरायमाणे नकुले कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अब्रवीद् भ्रातरं वीरं सहदेवमरिंदमम्॥
en: Seeing Nakula's delay, Yudhishthira the son of Kunti, said to his heroic brother Sahadeva, the tormentor of his foes,

sa: अद्य चन्दनसारस्य केयूरामोक्षणस्य च। वसूनां च विमोक्षस्य सुहृदां पालनस्य च॥ अनुरूपाविमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः। अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य कर्तृणां ते निवारणे॥
en: That hand, which is fit for the smearing of the Sandal, for wearing armlets, distributing wealth and maintaining relations, shall be engaged today, Oh Rāma, in performing its worthy action, the discomfiture of them who want to throw obstacles in the way of your installation.

sa: पूर्वं महाराज यदुप्रवीर ऋत्विकसुहृद् विप्रगणैश्च सार्धम्। पुण्यं प्रभासं समुपाजगाम यत्रोडुराड् यक्ष्मणा विश्यमानः॥ विमुक्तशापः पुनराप्य तेजः सर्वं जगद् भासयते नरेन्द्र। एवं तु तीर्थप्रवरं पृथिव्यां प्रभासनात् तस्य ततः प्रभासः॥
en: Accompanied by his priests and friends, Baladeva first went to the Tirthas called Prabhasa. There, the Lord of the asterism (viz., Soma), who had been suffering from phthisis, was freed from his disease. Regaining energy there, O king, be now lights up the universe. And because that foremost of Tirthas on Earth had formerly invested Soma again with effulgence, it is, therefore, called Prabhasa.

sa: न तस्य बीजं रोहति रोहकाले न तस्य वर्ष वर्षति वर्षकाले। भीतं प्रपन्नं प्रददति शत्रवे न स त्रातारं लभते त्राणमिच्छन्॥
en: He that makes over a man, stricken with fear who has sought refuge with him, to the enemy, does not get protection himself when he desires it. His seed cannot be sown at seed time nor does he get rain at the time for rains.

sa: राज्ञस्तत् सर्वमाचख्यौ मन्त्री विजयमुत्तमम्। पराजयं कुरूणां चाप्युपायान्तं तथोत्तरम्॥ सर्वा विनिर्जिता गावः कुरवश्च पराजिताः। उत्तरः सह सूतेन कुशली च परंतपः॥
en: The messenger then described to the king everything-the excellent victory, the defeat of the Kurus, and the expected arrival of Uttara. He said: "All the kine have been rescued, the Kurus have been vanquished, and Uttara, the slayer of enemies, fares well with his charioteer.”

sa: गृहन्ति सर्पा इव गह्वराणि स्वशिक्षया स्वेन वृत्तेन माः। तेषु प्रमुह्यन्ति जना विमूढा यथाध्वानं मोहयन्ते भयाय। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: Some men conceal their habits which are different from their teachings from others, as serpents conceal themselves in their holes. Men who are ignorant are deceived by them, who following the right Path deceive their victims into ruin. Ascetics perceive that Lord who is immortal.

sa: न शक्यन्ते ह्यस्य गुणाः प्रसंख्यातुं नरेश्वर। एष धर्मपरो नित्यमानृशंसश्च पाण्डवः॥ एवं युक्तो महाराजः पाण्डव: पार्थिवर्षभः। कथं नार्हति राजार्हमासनं पृथिवीपते।॥
en: O king! His great virtues cannot be counted. He, the son of Pandu is generous and always religion abiding. Oking! Why is Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu not entitled to the position of a king in spite of the best virtues resting in his personality?

sa: द्वादशेन तु भल्लेन चकर्तास्य ध्वजं तदा॥ ततो वज्रनिकाशेन फाल्गुनः प्रहसन्निव। त्रयोदशेनेन्द्रसमः कृपं वक्षस्यविध्यत॥ सच्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। गदापाणिरवप्लुत्य तूर्णं चिक्षेप तां गदाम्॥ सा च मुक्ता गदा गुर्वी कृपेण सुपरिष्कृता। अर्जुनेन शरैर्नुन्ना प्रतिमार्गमथागमत्॥ तं तु योधाः परीप्सन्तः शारद्वतममर्षणम्। सर्वतः समरे पार्थं शरवर्षेरवाकिरन्॥ ततो विराटस्य सुतः सव्यमावृत्य वाजिनः। यमकं मण्डलं कृत्वा तान् योधान् प्रत्यवारयत्॥ ततः कृपमुपादाय विरथं ते नरर्षभाः। अपजहुर्महावेगा कुन्तीपुत्राद
en: With the twelfth arrow he cut off his most excellent standard, and with the thirteenth resembling the thunder-bolt, Phalguni the equal of Indra, as if smiling, struck Kripa on the breast. Then with his bow cut off, dislodged from his car, his horses and charioteer slain, leaping down and taking up a mace, he soon hurled it at Arjuna. That shining and greatly polished mace hurled by him, came back baffled by Arjuna's shafts. Then to rescue the revengeful son of Sharadvata, all the soldiers covered Partha in battle on all sides with a downpour of shafts. Then turning the horses to the left and making the circle called Yamaka, Virata's son withstood all those warriors. Then taking Kripa with them, who had been dislodged from his car, all those leading warriors led him away from Dhananjaya, th

sa: पादौ संस्पृश्य मानार्हो भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य भारत। तथा तौ दुःखितौ दृष्ट्वा दुःशासनसुयोधनौ।॥ अधिगम्य व्यधाविष्टः कर्णस्तौ प्रत्यभाषत। विषीदथः किं कौरव्यौ बालिश्यात् प्राकृताविव॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, catching, the feet of his eldest brother who deserved worship from him. Having seen Dushasana in great grief and Duryodhana in greatest possible misery, Karna came to them and said, “O Kuru princes, why do you childishly weep like ordinary people?

sa: गच्छ लक्ष्मण पश्य त्वं भरतं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। नह्यहं जीवितुं शक्तस्तामृते जनकात्मजाम्॥ इति रामं महात्मानं विलपन्तमनाथवत्। उवाच लक्ष्मणो भ्राता वचनं युक्तमव्ययम्॥
en: Do you proceed, O Lakşmaņa, and join Bharata gifted with fraternal affection. I am incapable of living any more without that daughter of Janaka. Thereupon Lakşmaņa addressed to the high-souled Rāma who was thus bewailing like one helpless with the following pregnant and immutable words.

sa: दह्यमानो दिवाराचं विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्॥ चण्डालरूपिणं राम मुनिः कारुण्यमागतः। कारुण्यात् स महातेजा वाक्यं परमधार्मिकः॥ इदं जगाद भद्रं ते राजानं घोरदर्शनम्। किमागमनकार्यं ते राजपुत्र महाबल॥ अयोद्याधिपते वीर शापाच्चण्डालतां गतः।
en: And beholding to disappointed king in the guise of a Chandala, the ascetic, O Rāma, was touched with pity. And from commiseration, that pre-eminently pious and exceedingly energetic one said to that king frightful to behold, saying, 'Good betide you, O heroic lord of Ayodhya, you have fallen into Chandala-hood through a curse, what is the purpose of your coming, O highly powerful prince?'

sa: आनीय मधुपर्कं मां यत् पुरा त्वमवोचथाः। एष भ्राता सखा चैव तव कृष्ण धनंजयः॥ रक्षितव्यो महाबाहो सर्वास्वापत्स्विति प्रभो। तव चैव ब्रुवाणस्य तथेत्येवाहमब्रुवम्॥ स सव्यसाची गुप्तस्ते विजयी च जनेश्वर।
en: After I had arrived at Upaplavya, you the holder of Gandiva, gave me honey and the customary ingredients, and said, O Lord, This Dhananjaya, O Krishna, is your brother and SO friend! He should, therefore, be protected by you in all dangers!-To your these words I answered saying-So be it!-That Savyasachin has always been protected by me. You have also gained victory, O king.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा यज्ञे पुष्करस्थे पितामहे। अब्रुवन्नृषयो राजन्नायं यज्ञो महागुणः॥ न दृश्यते सरिच्छेष्टा यस्मादिह सरस्वती। तच्छुत्वा भगवान् प्रीतः सस्माराथ सरस्वतीम्॥
en: During the progress of that sacrifice at Pushkara and in the presence of Brahma, the Rishis, O king, said-"This sacrifice is not successful, sine that foremost of rivers, viz., Sarasvati, is not to be seen here.” Hearing these words. the divine Brahman meditated on Sarasvati.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं विरराम स पार्थिवः। यदा न शेकू राजानं याजनार्थं परंतपः॥ ततस्ते याजकः क्रुद्धास्तमूचुर्नृपसत्तमम्। तव कर्माण्यजस्रं वै वर्तन्ते पार्थिवोत्तम॥
en: Having said this, the king became silent. The Brahmanas knew well that they could not assist that chastiser of foes at his sacrifice; therefore they pretended to be angry with that best of kings and they said, "O best of kings, your sacrifices are incessant.

sa: संजय उवाच तमब्रवीद वासुदेवो रथस्थो राधेय दिष्ट्या स्मरसीह धर्मम्। प्रायेण नीचा व्यमनेषु मग्ना निन्दति दैवं कुकृतं न तु स्वम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then Krishna, who was on the car said to Karna-"Fortunate it is, O son of Radha, that you remember virtue. It is always seen that men, when they are in distress, speak ill of the providence and not of their own evil deeds.

sa: किं च ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च शक्रश्च बलभित् प्रभुः॥ सूर्यस्ताराधिपो वायुरग्निर्वरुण एव च। आकाशं जगती चैव ये च शेषा दिवौकसः॥ प्रलयं न विजानन्ति आत्मनः परिनिर्मितम्। ततस्तेनास्थिता मार्ग ध्रुवमक्षरमव्ययम्॥
en: Then, again, Brahman, and Rudra, the powerful Sakra the killer of Vala, the Sun, the Lord of the stars, the Wind-god, the god of fire, the god of the Waters, Infinite Space, the Universe too and the rest of the dwellers of heaven,-these, it seems do not know the way of securing an annihilation of conscious existence that is encompassed by one's own efforts.

sa: हारिद्रवर्णस्तु प्रजाविसर्गात् सहस्रशस्तिष्ठति संचरन् वै। अविप्रमुक्तो निरये च दैत्य ततः सहस्राणि दशापराणि॥ गतीः सहस्राणि च पञ्च तस्य चत्वारि संवर्तकृतानि चैवा विमुक्तमेनं निरयाच्च विद्धि सर्वेषु चान्येषु च सम्भवेषु॥
en: Having acquired the Yellow colour, Individual Soul exists for thousands of Kalpas, sporting as a Deity. Without, however, being emancipated, he has to live in hell, enjoying or enduring the fruits of his acts of past Kalpas and passing through nine and then thousand courses. Know that Individual Soul then becomes freed from the hell as represented heaven. Similarly Individual Soul escapes other births.

sa: पांसुभस्मकरीषाणां यथा वै राशयश्चिताः। सहसा वारिणा सिक्ता न यान्ति परिभावनम्॥ किञ्चित् स्निग्धं यथा च स्याच्छुष्कचूर्णमभावितम्। क्रमशस्तु शनैर्गच्छेत् सर्वं तत्परिभावनम्॥ एवमेवेन्द्रियग्रामं शनैः सम्परिभावयेत्। संहरेत् क्रमशश्चैव स सम्यक् प्रशमिष्यति॥
en: As when drenched with water, a mass of dust or ashes or of a burnt cow-dung, does not seem to be soaked, as it remains dry if drenched partially, and requires continued drenching before it becomes thoroughly soaked, so should the Yogin gradually control all his senses. He should gradually withdraw them (from all objects). The man who acts thus succeeds in controlling them.

sa: किमिदं कुरुषे मोहाद् विप्रस्त्वं हि कुलोद्वहः। मध्यदेशपरिज्ञातो दस्युभावं गतः कथम्॥ पूर्वान् स्मर द्विज ज्ञातीन् प्रख्यातान् वेदपारगान्। तेषां वंशेऽभिजातस्त्वमीदृशः कुलपांसनः॥
en: What is this that you are doing here out of ignorance. You are a Brahmana, and the perpetuator of a Brahmana family. Born in a respectable family belonging to the Middle country, how is it that you have become like a robber in your conduct.

sa: संजय उवाच इत्येवमुक्त्वा पुनरेव पार्थो युधिष्ठिरं धर्मभृता वरिष्ठम्। विमुच्य शस्त्राणि धनुर्विसृज्य कोशे च खङ्ग विनिधाय तूर्णम्॥ स वीडया नम्रशिराः किरीटी युधिष्ठिरं प्राञ्जलिरभ्युवाच। प्रसीद राजन् क्षम यन्मयोक्तं काले भवान् वेत्सस्यति तन्नमस्ते॥
en: Sanjaya said Having again thus addressed Yudhishthira, the foremost of the righteous, the diademdecked. Arjuna readily laid aside his weapons and bow and thursted his sword into the scabbard, having thus appeased Yudhishthira he huge down his head in shame and with joined hands thus addressed him-"O king, I bow unto you, be pleased with me; you will understand in due course the gist of all that I have told you."

sa: दयित: फाल्गुनो नित्यमाचार्यस्य महात्मनः। ततोऽस्य दत्तवान् द्वारमयुद्धेनैव शत्रुहन्।॥ अभयं सिन्धुराजाय दत्त्वा द्रोणः परंतपः। प्रादात् किरीटिने द्वारं पश्य निर्गुणतां मयि॥
en: (But) The afterwards allowed Kiriti to enter into the array. If he had before given permission to the king of Sindhu to return home, this dreadful havoc would never have taken place in battle. Jayadratha was for returning home in order to save his life.

sa: पश्चाच्छूर्पणखा नाम रामपार्श्वमुपागता। ततो रामेण संदिष्टो लक्ष्मणः सहसोत्थितः॥ प्रगृह्य खङ्गं चिच्छेद कर्णनासे महाबलः। ततस्तेनार्दिता बाला रावणं समुपागता॥ रावणानुचरो घोरो मारीचो नाम राक्षसः। लोभयामास वैदेहीं भूत्वा रत्नमयो मृगः॥
en: Thereafter (a she-demon) named Surpanakha, came to the side of Rāma. Thereupon being commanded by Rāma, the highly powerful Lakşmaņa rose up all on a sudden and taking a dagger chopped off her ears and nose. Being thus insulted by him that she-demon came to Rāmana. Thereupor a dreadful Rākşasa named Mārīca-an attendant of Rāvaņa, assuming the shape of a jewelled deer, allured Vaidehī.

sa: रावणं भज भर्तारं भर्तारं सर्वरक्षसाम्। विक्रान्तमापतन्तं च सुरेशमिव वासवम्॥ दक्षिणं त्यागशीलं च सर्वस्य प्रियवादिनम्। मानुषं कृपणं रामं त्यक्त्वा रावणमाश्रय॥
en: Do you accept, Rāvana, the lord of the Rākşasa host, as your husband. He withstands powerfully his enemies like to Vāsava, the lord of the celestials, charitable, kind to all, and sweet-speeched. And forsaking Rāma, a poor wight, do you take Rāvana (as your husband)

sa: ऋषीणां देवतानां च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा। नागानामथ यक्षाणां राज्ञां च रजनीचर॥ यच्च पापं कृत मोहादवलिप्तेन राक्षस। नूनं ते विगतो दर्पः स्वयंभूवरदानजः॥ यस्य दण्डधरस्तेऽहं दाराहरणकर्शितः। दण्डं धारयमाणस्तु लङ्काद्वारे व्यवस्थितः॥
en: You have, O night-ranger, through delusion and pride injured saints and celestials, and Gandharvas and Apsaras, and Serpents, and Yaksas, and crowned heads. But, O Raksasa, your pride begot of the boon received from the Self-create has gone from you, whose destroyer I, afflicted in consequence of my wife having been carried off, wielding the rod, have sat down at the door of Lankā.

sa: अब्रवीत्तु तदा वाक्यं नारदो भगवानृषिः। श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि विधानं च विधीयताम्॥ एष नाम्नो दशग्रीवा पितृराज निशाचरः। उपयाति वशं नेतुं विक्रभैस्त्वां सुदुर्जयम्॥
en: Thereat the reverend sage, Narada, said; Hearken. I shall tell (you); and (after hearing me out) do you what is fit. o king of the Pitrs, here come the night-ranger named ten-necked, for bringing you under his sway you who are incapable of being conquered.

sa: हनुमानङ्गदो नीलः सुषेणः कुमुदो नलः। गजो गवाक्षः पनसः सानुप्रस्थो महाहरिः॥ जाम्बवानृषभः सुन्दो रम्भः शतबलिः पृथुः। व्यूढानीकाश्च यत्ताश्च दुमानादाय सर्वतः॥ वीक्षमाणा दिशः सर्वास्तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च वानराः। तृणेष्वपि च चेष्टत्सु राक्षसा इति मेनिरे॥
en: And Hanumān, and Angada, and Nīla, and Susena, and Kumuda, and Nala, and Gaya, and Gavākṣa, and Panas, and Sānuprastha-a mighty monkey-and Jämbavān, and Rishava, and Sunda, and Rambha, and Satabali, and Prthu, all forming them selves into array, and equipped with trees on all sides, and remaining vigilantthe monkeys kept gazing at all sides, awry and upwards; and even when a straw stirred, they thought it to be a Rākşasa.

sa: भगीरथस्तु राजर्षिः कृत्वा सलिलमुत्तमम्। यथाक्रमं यथान्यायं सागराणां महायशाः॥ कृतोदकः शुची राजा स्वपुरं प्रविवेश ह। समृद्धार्थो नरश्रेष्ठ स्वराज्यं प्रशशास ह॥
en: The royal saint king Bhagiratha also of high fame having performed his ablutions and purified himself, and duly and in proper order offered oblations of water to the sons of Sagara, entered his capital. And attaining exceeding prosperity, that foremost of men ruled his kingdom.

sa: ते सुतीर्थां ततः कृच्छ्रादुपगम्य यशस्विनः। नदी मन्दाकिनी रम्यां सदा पुष्पितकाननाम्॥ शीघ्रस्रोतसमासाद्य तीर्थं शिवमकर्दमम्। सिषिचुस्तूदकं राज्ञे तत एतद् भवत्विति ॥
en: Then those illustrious ones, having in distress arrived at the river Mandākini, Mandākini, having convenient descents, charming, ever furnished with blossomag woods, and of rapid currents; and approached it descents, goodly and void of mud, offered water to the monarch, uttering, “May this be so!"

sa: व्रीडितं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह। एष मन्ये महाबाहुरिहास्मान् द्रष्टुमागतः॥ अथवा नौ ध्रुवं मन्ये मन्यमानः सुखोचितौ। वनवासमनुध्याय गृहाय प्रतिनेष्यति॥
en: And finding Lakşmaņa overcome with shame, Rāghava replied, I think that mighty-armed one has come hither to see us; or I take it for certain that, considering that we are fit for ease only, and taking our banishment to heart, he will take us home.

sa: हटोऽभवद्धषीकेशः साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत्। तथा ब्रुवति वार्ष्णेये प्रहृष्टवदने तदा॥ द्रौपदी त्वरिता गत्वा वैराटी वाक्यमब्रवीत्। अयमायाति ते भद्रे श्वशुरो मधुसूदनः॥
en: When he of Vrishni's racc said so and presented such a chcerful look, Draupadi, going there quickly, addressed the daughter of Virata, saying, O blessed lady, here comes to you your father-in-law, the destroyer of Madhu, that ancient Rishi of inconceivable soul, that unvanquished one.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा च गत्वा च भीष्ममूचुः कुमारकाः॥ ब्राह्मणस्य वचस्तथ्यं तच्च कर्म तथाविधम्। भीष्मः श्रुत्वा कुमाराणां द्रोणं तं प्रत्यजानत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Saying "Be it so," the princes went to Bhishma and told him all that the Brahmana had said and done. Hearing from the princes everything, Bhishma (at once) recognised Drona and thought that he would be the best preceptor (for the princes.)

sa: पीतः समुद्रोऽगस्त्येन ह्यगाधो ब्रह्मतेजसा। तस्माद् ब्रुवन्तु सर्वेऽत्र बटुरेष धनुर्महान्॥ आरोपयतु शीघ्रं वै तथेत्यूचुर्द्विजर्षभाः। एवं तेषां विलपतां विप्राणां विविधा गिरः॥
en: Agastya drank up the unfathomable ocean by his Brahma might. Therefore say, “Let this youth bend the bow and string it with ease.” The best of the Brahmanas said, “Be it so." The Brahmanas continued to talk thus to one another and on various matters.

sa: कोऽर्थो मनीषितस्तुभ्यं स्वर्गलाभो परोऽथवा। वराश्रयो यदर्थं त्वं तपस्यन्यैः सुदुश्चरम्॥ यमाश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस। ब्राह्मणो वासि भद्रं ते क्षत्रियो वासि दुर्जयः। वैश्यस्तृतीयो वर्णो ता शूद्रो वा सत्यवाग्भव ॥
en: For what are you going through such hard austerities? Is it heaven or anything else that you pray for? O ascetic, I wish to hear, of the purpose for which you are performing such hard penances. a Brāhmaṇa, or irrepressible Kșatriya or the third caste Vaisyas or a Śūdra? Do you speak the truth and you shall be crowned with auspiciousness Art you an

sa: दाहकाले खाण्डवस्य कुरुक्षेत्रं गतो ह्यसौ। न च शक्यौ युधा जेतुं कथंचिदपि वासव॥ वासुदेवार्जुनावेतौ निबोध वचनान्मम। नरनारायणावेतौ पूर्वदेवौ दिवि श्रुतौ॥ भवानप्यभिजानाति यद्वी? यत्पराक्रमौ। नैतौ शक्यौ दुराधर्षों विजेतुमजितौ युधि॥
en: O Vasava, known from what I say that none can ever defeat in battle Vasudeva (Krishna) and Arjuna. They are Nara and Narayana. These two Rishis were formerly heard of in heavens. You will know what is their prowess and energy. They are invincible in battle; these two best of old Rishis are incapable of ever being defeated by any in all the worlds.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनश्चापि राधेयश्च विशाम्पते। धृतराष्ट्रमुपागम्य वचोऽब्रूतामिदं तदा॥ संनिधौ विदुरस्य त्वां वक्तुं न शक्नुवः। विविक्तमिति वक्ष्याव: किं तवेदं चिकीर्षितम्॥ सपत्नवृद्धिं यत् तात मन्यसे वृद्धिमात्मनः। अभिष्टौषि च यत् क्षत्तुः समीपे द्विषतां वर॥
en: O king, then there came to Dhritarashtra Duryodhana and the son of Radha (Karna) and they thus spoke to him, “We are incapable of speaking wicked designs before Vidura, We have now found you alone; we shall, therefore, speak to you all that we desire to say. O father, are you considering the prosperity of the enemy as your own? O best of men, you were applauding the Pandavas before Kshatta.

sa: गौरमुख उवाच शमीको नाम राजेन्द्र वर्तते विषये तव॥ ऋषिः परमधर्मात्मा दान्तः शान्तो महातपाः। तस्य त्वया नरव्याघ्र सर्पः प्राणैर्वियोजितः॥ तक्षकः सप्तरात्रेण अवसक्तो धनुष्कोट्या स्कन्धे मौनान्वितस्य च। क्षान्तवांस्तव तत्कर्म पुत्रस्तस्य न चक्षमे॥
en: Gaurmukha said : O king of kings, there lives within your dominions, a Rishi, named Shamika. He is greatly virtuous, very peaceful, his passions under control and a great ascetic. O best of men, a dead snake was placed by you with the end of your bow on the shoulder of this Rishi who was then observing the vow of silence. He himself forgave the act, but his son did not.

sa: जटाः कृत्वाऽऽत्मनः सर्वे वल्कलाजिनवाससः। सह कुन्त्या महात्मानो बिभ्रतस्तापसं वपुः॥ क्वचिद् वहन्तो जननीं त्वरमाणा महारथाः। क्वचिच्छन्देन गच्छन्तस्ते जग्मुः प्रसभं पुनः॥
en: They all made matted locks and wore the barks of trees. Those illustrious (heroes) assumed the form of ascetics with their mother. Those car-warriors some times proceeded in haste, carrying their mother, (on their back) sometimes they proceeded slowly; they then went in great haste.

sa: तुल्यो हि प्रणयस्तेषां प्रद्युम्नस्य च भाविनि। एवमादि प्रियं सत्यं हृद्यमुक्त्वा मनोऽनुगम्॥ गमनाय मनश्चक्रे वासुदेवरथं प्रति। तां कृष्णां कृष्णमहिषी चकाराभिप्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: O beautiful lady, their affection for your sons is equal to what they feel for Pradyumna." Having said these agreeable, truthful and delighting and cordial words, Satyabhama desired to go to the chariot of Vasudeva (Krishna). The wife of Krishna then walked round Krishna (Draupadi).

sa: स तस्य वचनात् तयैव सह देव्या तद् वनं प्राविशत्। स कदाचित् तस्मिन् कानने रम्ये तयैव सह व्यवाहरदथ क्षुत्तृष्णार्दितः श्रान्तोऽतिमुक्तकागार-मपश्यत्॥
en: At these words of the minister, he (the king) entered that forest with his beautiful wife. One day when he was sporting in that charming forest, he became tired and fatigued and afflicted with hunger and thirst. He then saw a bower of Madhavi (creeper).

sa: दृश्यन्ते निष्फलाः सन्तः प्रहीणाः सर्वकर्मभिः। भूतानामयरः कश्चिद्धिंसायां सततोत्थितः॥ वञ्चनायां च लोकस्य स सुखी जीवते सदा। अचेष्टमपि चासीनं श्री: कंचिदुपतिष्ठति॥
en: Are seen to have been baffled in their efforts; and they attain the fruits of their actions. Persons who are always active in injuring others and in practising deception lead a happy life in this world. There are many who obtain prosperity without any exertion.

sa: ददाह सुमहातेजा मन्दबुद्धीन् स सागरान्। तान् दृष्ट्वा भस्मसाद् भूतान् नारदः सुमहातपाः॥ सगरान्तिकमागच्छत् तच्च तस्मै न्यवेदयत्। स तच्छ्रुत्वा वचो घोरं राजा मुनिमुखोद्गतम्॥ मुहूर्तं विमना भूत्वा स्थाणोर्वाक्यमचिन्तयत्। अंशुमन्तं समाहूय असमञ्जःसुतं तदा॥ पौत्रं भरतशार्दूल इदं वचनमब्रवीत्। षष्टिस्तानि सहस्राणि पुत्राणाममितौजसाम्॥ कापिलं तेज आसाद्य मत्कृते निधनं गताः। तव चापि पिता तात परित्यक्तो मयानघ। धर्म संरक्षमाणेन पौराणां हितमिच्छता॥
en: That greatly effulgent one burnt down those foolish-minded sons of Sagara. Having seen them reduced to ashes, the great ascetic Narada came to Sagara and told him all that had happened. Having heard those terrible words, uttered from the lips of the Rishi, the king (Sagara) remained unconscious for some time; he then thought of the words of Sthanu (Shiva). Then calling Anshuman, the son of Asamanjasa his grandson, O best of Bharata race, he spoke these words. "My sixty thousands immeasurably powerful sons, falling under the effulgence of Kapila, has met with their death on my account. O child, O sinless one, your father also has been abandoned by me from my desire to protect the citizens and to save my virtue.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञस्तमनुमान्य च। संजयो बाढमित्युक्त्वा प्राद्रवत् काम्यकं प्रति॥ सोऽचिरेण समासाद्य तद् वनं यत्र पाण्डवाः। रौरवाजिनसंवीतं ददर्शाथ युधिष्ठिरम्॥ विदुरेण सहासीनं ब्राह्मणैश्च सहस्रशः। भ्रातृभिश्चाभिसंगुप्तं देवैरिव पुरंदरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of the king, Sanjaya respectfully approved them and saying “Be it so", he set out for the Kamyaka (forest). He soon arrived at the forest where were the Pandavas, He saw Yudhishthira, clad in deer skin, guarded by his brothers and seated with Vidura and thousands of Brahmanas, like Purandara (Indra) in the midst of the celestials.

sa: व्यक्ति भीत इवाभ्येति राजासौ भीष्ममन्तिकम्। युधिष्ठिरः ससोदर्यः शरणार्थं प्रयाचकः॥ धनंजये कथं नाथे पाण्डवे च वृकोदरे। नकुले सहदेवे च भीतिरभ्येति पाण्डवम्॥ न नूनं क्षत्रियकुले जातः सम्प्रथिते भुवि। यथाऽस्य हृदयं भीतमल्यसत्त्वस्य संयुगे॥
en: Yudhishthira with his brothers has become a sceker after Bhishma's protection. When Dhananjaya is protector and the sons of Pandu, Vrikodara (Bhima), Nakula and Sahadeva, why does this Pandavas (Yudhishthira) come (to Bhishma) in fear. Though celebrated in the world, this one could never have been born in the Kshatriya order, for he is weak and his heart is filled with fear of battle”. Then those warriors all praised the Kurus.

sa: इमाः काशिपतेः कन्या मया निर्जत्य पार्थिवान्। विचित्रवीर्यस्य कृते वीर्यशुल्का हृता इति।॥
en: These daughters, of the king of the Kashis having prowess for their dower, have been taken away by me after vanquishing the ruler of the earth.

sa: एका मूर्तिस्तपश्चर्यां कुरुते मे भुवि स्थिता। अपरा पश्यति जगत् कुर्वाणं साध्वसाधुनी॥
en: One of my semblance's, remaining on earth, is even now practising ascetic austerities. Another keeps an eye over the world engaged in good and evil deeds.

sa: मुमुचुः शोणितं भूरि केचिद् भिन्ना विषाणाचैर्भिन्नकुम्भाश्च तोमरैः। विनदन्तोऽभ्यधावन्त गर्जमाना घना इव॥
en: Some of these with bodies mangled with tusk wounds, others with their temples rent by broad-headed shafts, careered all over the field roaring like roaring clouds.

sa: वीर्यशुल्काश्च ता ज्ञात्वा समारोप्य रथं तदा। अवोचं पार्थिवान् सर्वानहं तत्र समागतान्।
en: Knowing that prowess constituted their dower, I took them over to my chariot and said to all those rulers of the earth who were assembled there.

sa: ततो वादित्रघोषेण शंखनां च महास्वनैः। प्रादुरासीत् कृते द्रोणे हर्षः सेनापतौ तदा॥
en: thereupon on Drona's investiture with the command, the delight (of troops) was manifest by the sound of musical instruments and the deafening blare of the conchs.

sa: ततो नागस्य तद् वर्म व्यधमत् पाकशासनिः। शरजालेन महता तद् वयशीर्यत भूतले॥
en: was numerous Thereafter Arjuna shattered into pieces the armour covering Bhagadatta's elephant, with a mighty shower of arrows, the armour then dropped down on the earth.

sa: पर्वतः। पत्रिभिः। महेन्द्रप्रतिमं कार्णि छादयामास तेन ते विशिखा मुक्ता यमदण्डोपमाः शिताः॥
en: Paired, with winged shafts, that nephew of Krishna, who resembled the great Indra himself. Those sharp arrows, resembling the rod of Death, discharged by the Rakshasa,

sa: यथैष निनदो घोरः श्रूयते राक्षसेरितः। हैडिम्बो युध्यते नूनं राज्ञा दुर्योधनेन ह॥
en: As I hear these dreadful roars uttered by the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, I think it sure that the son of Hidimba is engaged with king Duryodhana himself.

sa: स त्वं कवचमास्थाय क्रुद्धपद्य रणेऽर्जुनम्। त्वरमाणः स्वयं यानि न त्वासौ विसहिष्यति॥
en: So, cased in this golden armour, do you hastily advance upon the wrathful Arjuna, yourself; he shall not be able to beat you in battle today.

sa: असिना धनुषा शक्त्या हयैर्नागैर्नरै रथैः। आयसेन च दण्डेन वातान् वातान् हनिष्यति॥
en: He will slay crowds upon crowds of our host, using his sword, bow, darts, iron mace and horses, elephants, men and chariots as implements for striking.

sa: लेलिहन् सृक्किणी वीरो मृगराडिव कानने। भीमस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठो गदां गृह्य महाहवे॥
en: Licked the corners of his mouth, like the king of beasts in the forest. Thereafter that foremost of car-warriors, grasping his mace, in that fierce battle,

sa: अथवा भरतश्रेष्ठ निर्जित्य युधि पाण्डवान्। राज्यं सम्प्रति दत्त्वा च सौभ्रात्रं कर्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: Or, O foremost of the Bharatas, having defeated the Pandavas in battle, you desire to re-establish brotherly feelings (with them), by giving them back their kingdom.

sa: यथा दिवि महाघोरौ राजन् बुधशनैश्चरौ। तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सूतं च नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Then that slayer of hostile heroes, that son of Subhadra, endued with prowess, slaying Chitrasena's four steeds and charioteer with nine shafts, uttered his fierce war-cry.

sa: ताभिः परिवृतः संख्ये सर्वेश्चैव महारथैः। कथं शक्येत संद्रष्टुं दुरात्मा कृष्ण सैन्धवः॥
en: Surrounded by all these troops, as also by all their mighty car-warriors, how could that wicked-souled ruler of the Sindhus, O Krishna, be seen (by us)?

sa: एष योत्स्यति संग्रामे सूदयन् वै परान् रणे। भगवानिव संक्रुद्धः पिनाकी युगसंक्षये॥
en: He will fight in the battle destroying the enemies in the fight like the wrathful god, bearing the Pinaka at the time of the universal destruction.

sa: कुबेरस्य विहारे च नलिनी पद्मभूषिताम्। सरिच्छेष्ट्रां च तां गङ्गां वीक्षमाणो बहूदकाम्॥
en: He beheld in the pleasure-garden of Kubera, the delightful lake adorned with lotuses. He also beheld that most excellent of rivers namely Ganga of copious waters.

sa: संजय उवाच एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं वासुदेवः सहार्जुनः। प्रसादयामास भवं तदा शस्त्रोपलब्धये॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus having eulogised the great god, Arjuna and the son of Vasudeva began to propitiate the former for obtaining the weapon (Pasupata) from him.

sa: तथैव तव पुत्रस्य रथोदाराः प्रहारिणः। न शेकुः पाण्डवीं सेनां पाल्यमानां किरीटिना॥
en: So also the car-warriors of your son's host, skillful in smiting down the enemy could not vanguish the Pandava division led by the diadem-decked Arjuna himself.

sa: अश्मसारमयं नूनं हृदयं सुदृढं मम। यच्छ्रुत्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रं हतं भीष्मं न दीर्यते॥
en: Hard as my heart is, it is surely made of stone that it does not break on hearing the death of the foremost of men, Bhishma.

sa: एतेन हि तदा रांजस्तप आस्थाय दारुणम्। सुदुर्लभो वरो लब्धः पाण्डवान् योद्धमाहवे।॥
en: After that defeat, severe austerities were practiced by him O king; he has obtained a boon, difficult to get, of fighting with the Pandavas in battle.

sa: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत् तत् प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्। नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: His mind is steady who has no attachment for any thing; and who neither feels exultation nor aversion on receiving either the good or the bad.

sa: हतो भीष्मो हतो भीष्मस्तत्र तत्र वचो महत्। अश्रूयत महाराज वासुदेवभयात् तदा॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, exclamations of 'Bhishma is slain, Bhishma is slain' were heard there, uttered by your troops inspired with the fear of Vasudeva's son.

sa: स्पर्धते वासुदेवेन नित्यं यो वै रणे रणे। भागिनेयान् निजांस्त्यक्त्वा शल्यस्तेऽतिरथो मतः।
en: Who ever considers him an equal to Vasudeva in every battle; abandoning his own nephews (sister's sons) Shalya that Atiratha, has came over to your side.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा महत्या सेनया वृतः। आवन्त्यौ समरे क्रुद्धावभ्ययात् स परंतपौ॥
en: Thereupon king Yudhishthira surrounded by a mighty division of troops rushed to those two afflicter of foes viz., the princes of Avanti both inflamed with wrath.

sa: एष चापि नरव्याघ्रां मत्कृते जीवितं त्यजेत्। एष नः सपयस्तात तारयेम परस्परम्॥
en: This foremost of men also will lay down his own life for my sake. This O sire, is our understanding, that we will protect one another.

sa: संजय उवाच यथा स भगवान् व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्। तथैव सहिताः सर्वे समाजग्मुर्महीक्षितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Just as the holy Rishi Krishna Dvaipayana Vyasa said, so exactly in that manner those rulers of earth who had assembled there met together.

sa: समयस्तु कृतः कश्चिन्नमम भीष्मेण संयुगे। मन्त्रयिष्ये तवार्थाय न तु योत्स्ये कथञ्चन॥
en: Before this battle there was an understanding between me and Bhishma. He said 'I will give you good counsel, but will not fight for your interests.

sa: तं चेत् पितामहं वृद्धं हन्तुमिच्छामि माधव। पितुः पितरमिष्टं च धिगस्तु क्षत्रजीविकाम्॥
en: O Madhava, even such an aged grandsire, I want to slay-him who is the father of our dearloved father! Fie on the life of a Kshatriya.”

sa: नावधीत् कृतवर्माणं प्राप्तमष्यरिषूदनः। तं दृष्ट्वा तु तथा यान्तं शूरो राजा श्रुतायुधः॥
en: That slayer of foes then did not slay Kritavarman though he had an opportunity for doing so. Then beholding him thus advance, the valorous king Shrutayusha.

sa: एतदर्थं मया तात पञ्च ग्रामा वृताः पुरा। कथं तव सुदुर्बुद्धे न प्रेक्ष्ये व्यसनं महत्॥
en: It was for this reason, my dear brothers, that I asked for five villages only before; why is it that you do not realize this great calamity, O you of exceedingly sinful understanding?

sa: ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च चक्रुः स्वस्त्ययनं महत्। लोकानां नृप शान्त्यर्थं क्रोधिते पाण्डवे तदा॥
en: Then, O king, when the son of Pandu was thus enraged, the Rishis and the celestial performed many benediction ceremonies for the peace of the worlds.

sa: विस्कार्य च धनूंष्यन्ये ज्याः परे परिमृज्य च। विनिःश्वसन्तः प्राक्रोशन् क्वेदानीं सधनंजयः॥
en: Stretching their bows and drawing back the strings of their bow with their hands and breathing (hot), they began to exclaim, 'where now is that Dhananjaya.'

sa: हताश्वश्च ततस्तूर्णं वृषकस्य रथं ययौ। श्यालस्य ते महाराज तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thereafter leaving his chariot of which the steeds were slain, Kritavarma ascended the car of your brother-in-law Vrishka, O monarch, before the yes of your son.

sa: नातिलक्ष्यतया कश्चिन्न शौर्यं न पराक्रमे। बभूव सदृशः काङ्गेर्नास्त्रे नापि च लाघवे॥
en: None among them equaled the son of Arjuna in sureness of aim, in bravery in prowess, in lightness of hands or in the knowledge of weapons.

sa: यस्माद् द्विषसि गोविन्दं पाण्डवं तं धनंजयम्। नरनारायणौ देवौ कोऽन्यो द्विष्याद्धि मानवः॥
en: For this reason it is that you despise Govinda and Dhananjaya the son of Pandu; for what other man could despise the divine Nara and Narayana?

sa: तमहं पातयिष्यामि रथात् तव पितामहम्। अहं भीष्मवधात् सृष्टो नूनं धात्रा महात्मना॥
en: I shall fell down that grand gather of yours from the chariot. I was surely created by the great souled Creator for the slaying of Bhishma.

sa: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षि रदस्तथा। असितो देवलो व्यास: स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे॥
en: All the Rishis, as well as the divine sages Narada, Asita, Devala, are thus. And you too, O Keshava, tell me yourself that it is so.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन। इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजाह्नवरिसूदन॥
en: Arjuna said "O slayer of enemies, O slayer of Madhu, how shall I attack in this battle with arrows Bhishma and Drona, deserving of my worship?

sa: त्रसानां खलु सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठा राजन् जरायुजाः। जरायुजानां प्रवरा मानवाः पशवश्च ये॥
en: O king, among mobile creatures, those that are viviparous are certainly the foremost. Among viviparous man is certainly the foremost, and next to man is animal.

sa: नावहास्या यथा वीरं भवेम परमाहवे। तथा कुरु रणे यत्नं साधयस्व पितामहम्॥
en: O hero, so exert yourself, that we may not be held in ridicule in this fierce battle. Struggling vigorously in battle, do you slay the grandsire.

sa: न भयाद् वासुदेवस्य न चापि तव फाल्गुन। राज्यं प्रतिप्रदास्यामि युद्ध्यस्व सहकेशवः॥
en: Nor from fear of Vasudeva, nor form fear of you, O Falguna, shall I give you back the kingdom therefore do you fight along with Keshava.

sa: ततोऽभूद् द्विपदां श्रेष्ठो वामं पार्श्वमुपाश्रितः॥ सर्वस्य जगतो गोप्ता गोप्ता यस्य जनार्दनः।
en: Next to them, on the left side, was that foremost of men, Arjuna who had as his protector Janardana (Krishna) the protector of the whole universe.

sa: शिखण्डिनि हते यक्षाः स्वं रूपं प्रतिपत्स्यते। स्थूणो यक्षो निरुद्वेगो भवत्विति महामनाः॥
en: On the death of Shikhandin 0 you Yakshas of high minds, he shall regain his own form. Therefore let the Yaksha Sthuna be free from anxiety.

sa: स्थाणुरुवाच प्रजासर्गनिमित्तं हि कृतो यत्नस्त्वया विभो। त्वया सृष्टाश्च वृद्धाश्च भूतग्रामाः पृथग्विधाः॥
en: Sthanu said O Lord, you did take great pains for creating various creatures. All these different sorts of beings have been created and reared by you.

sa: न भयाद् वासुदेवस्य न चापि तव फाल्गुन। राज्यं प्रतिप्रदास्यामि युद्ध्यस्व सहकेशवः॥
en: Nor from fear of Vasudeva, nor form fear of you, O Falguna, shall I give you back the kingdom therefore do you fight along with Keshava.

sa: कन्यार्थे कुरुराजस्य राजानो मृदिता युधि॥ तथा च बलवान् राजा जरासंधो दुरासदः।
en: You humiliated in battle all the other kings, for securing the bride for the king of the Kurus. Even the invincible king Jarasandha endued with might,

sa: स राजा प्रेतकृत्यानि तस्य कृत्वा शुचान्वितः। शोचनहनि रात्री च नालभत् सुखमात्मनः॥
en: Performing the funeral ceremonies of his son, king Akampana became purified. But bewailing his son, day and night. he could not regain his peace of mind.

sa: एकेन सह संयुक्तः प्रपन्नो विमुखस्तथा। क्षीणशस्त्रो विवर्मा च न हन्तव्यः कदाचन॥
en: One fighting with another, one seeking refuge, one retreating, one whose weapon is broken and one who is not clad in armour should never be struck.

sa: समुद्रस्येव महतो भुजाभ्यां प्रतरन् नरः। पुत्राणां व्यसनं मन्ये ध्रुवं प्राप्तं सुदारुणम्॥
en: Like a man desirous of swimming over the vast sea with his two arms. I now certainly see that a terrible calamity has overtaken my sons.

sa: न चापि पाण्डवा युद्धे भज्येरन्निति मे मतिः। शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः॥
en: I think also, that the Pandavas, brave. endued with might, learned in the use of weapons and invincible in battle, will never be routed in battle.

sa: ध्रुवं विनाशः सम्प्राप्तः पुत्राणां मम संजय। तस्मान्मे कारणं सूत शक्तिं चैव विशेषतः॥ पृच्छतो वै यथातत्त्वं सर्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि। दुर्योधनश्च यच्चक्रे दृष्ट्वा स्वान् विमुखान् रणे॥
en: The destruction of my sons in battle is certain, O Sanjaya. Therefore, O Suta, it behaves you to tell me who am questioning you, in detail and truly, the real cause of these events, as also, what Duryodhana did, seeing his own troops turn their face away from the field of battle.

sa: अपृच्छद् वाष्पसंरुद्धो निःश्वसन वाचमीरयन्। मम प्राणैः प्रियतमः क्व भीम इति दुःखितः॥
en: Overwhelmed with grief, his voice choked up with tears and breathing heavily he questioned Vishoka saying: “Where is Bhimasena, dearer to me than my own life?"

sa: यावन्न ते चमूः चमूः सर्वाः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। नाशयत्यर्जुनस्तावत् संधिस्ते तात युज्यताम्॥
en: O son! Your alliance with Arjuna is must to be made unless he destroys your whole army by hitting hard through the arrows having bent knots.

sa: अपुत्रया मया राजन् सपत्नीनां भयादिदम्। कन्या शिखण्डिनी जाता पुरुषो वै निवेदिता॥
en: Childless as I was, O great king, and from fear of my companion, wives, my daughter Shikhandin, when born, was represented to you as a son,

sa: अशक्यमिति सा यक्षं पुनः पुनरुवाच ह। करिष्यामीति वै क्षिप्रं प्रत्युवाचाथ गुह्यकः॥
en: "It cannot be performed”, she replied to the Yaksha again and again. But that Guhyaka returned her answer immediately (by saying) “I shall surely do it."

sa: अश्विनौ श्रवणौ नित्यं देवी जिह्वा सरस्वती। वेदाः संस्कारनिष्ठा हि त्वयीदं जगदाश्रितम्॥
en: The twin Ashvins ever constitute your ears, the goddess of leading is your tongue, the Vedas are your knowledge and in you is this world stationed.

sa: व्यंसितं वीक्ष्य निस्त्रिंशं सौभद्रेण रणे तदा। साधु साध्विति सैन्यानां प्रणादोऽभूद् विशाम्पते॥
en: Beholding the sword thus baffled by the son of Subhadra, in that battle, the troops, O ruler of men, set up an uproar crying 'well-done' 'well-done'.

sa: वयं त्वप्रतिमं वीर्ये सर्वे सौभद्रमात्मजम्। उक्तवन्तः स्म तं तात भिन्ध्यनीकमिति प्रभो॥
en: Then we all, O sire, spoke to Subhadra's son, who was unequalled in his prowess, saying-'O lord, do you break through these divisions of the enemy.'

sa: इदानीं च विजानामि सुकृतं मधुसूदन। कृतं राज्ञा महाबाहो याचता च सुयोधनम्॥
en: Now, O slayer of Madhu, do I realize what a great act of piety, O mighty-armed, one, did the king (Yudhishthira) do by begging of Suyodhana,

sa: अधनस्य मृतं श्रेयो न च ज्ञातिवधाद् धनम्। किं न प्राप्स्यामहे कृष्ण हत्वा ज्ञातीन् समागतान्॥
en: Death is preferable, for him who has no wealth, to the acquisition of wealth by the slaughter of his kinsmen. What good 0 Krishna, shall we reap, slaughtering these our kinsmen assembled together.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तुभ्यमाचार्यस्य कृपस्य च। कर्णेन सहितः कृत्यं चिन्तयानस्तदैव हि॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, hearing such words from you and from the preceptor (Drona), I would have then with Karna reflected what we should have done.

sa: ततोऽभिमन्युः प्रहसन सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। सारथे को न्वयं द्रोणः समग्र क्षत्रमेव वा॥
en: Thereupon Abhimanyu, with a a smile, replied to his charioteer saying-"O charioteer, who is indeed this Drona? What avails all this vast host of the Kshatriyas?

sa: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्। मम वानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः॥
en: I bestow my favours (on all men) in the way in which they worship Me. All men, O Partha, follow in my path, in every way.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच नदन्ति नाद्य तूर्योणि मङ्गल्यानि जनार्दन। मिश्रा दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः शङ्खाश्चाडम्बरैः सह॥
en: Arjuna said O Jaraddana, the auspicious drums are not best today and their sound does not add to the din created by the trumpet-blasts and conchblares.

sa: अनिष्टं चैव मे श्लिष्टं हृदयान्नापसर्पति। भुवि ये दिक्षु चात्युग्रा उत्पातास्त्रासयन्ति माम्॥
en: Thoughts, such as a calamity has befallen me, occupying my heart, does not leave it; on earth, in all the directions, various dreadful portents affright me.

sa: वैरिणं जहि दुर्धर्षं भगदत्तं सुरद्विषम्। यथाऽहं जनिवान् पूर्वं हितार्थं नरकं तथा॥
en: Now slay in battle your invincible opponent Bhagadatta, that enemy of the gods, like myself slaying, in the days of yore, Naraka, for the worlds' benefit.

sa: सहिताः पाण्डवं सर्वे पीडयन्तः समन्ततः। तं दृष्ट्वा संशयं प्राप्तं पीड्यमानं महारथम्॥
en: Thus united together, they sorely pressed that son of Pandu (Bhima) on all sides. Beholding that mighty car-warrior thus involved in a predicament and thus afflicted,

sa: न तासां नामदेयानि परिमाणं तथैव च॥ शक्यन्ते परिसंख्यातुं पुण्यास्ता हि सरिद्वराः।
en: It is impossible to mention the names and lengths of these rivers. All of them are the foremost of all rivers, and they are all sincleansing.

sa: यः प्रतीयाद् रणेद्रोणं यावद् गच्छामि पाण्डवम्। मा च ते भयमद्यास्तु राजन्नर्जुनसम्भवम्॥
en: Who will advance against Drona for protecting you, when I shall proceed towards Arjuna? Let no fear, O king, assail your heart today on Arjuna's account.

sa: ये चापि नासन् व्यथिता मनुष्यस्तेषां करेभ्यः पतितं हि शस्रम्। भयाच संचुक्रुशुरस्वरैस्ते निमीलिताक्षा ददृसुः समन्ततः॥
en: Others who were not thus struck down were also so affected with fear that they lost hold of their weapons and some with half closed eyes looked fearfully towards Bhimasena uttering meaningless ejaculations.

sa: आश्चर्ये तत्र राजेन्द्र सुमहद् दृष्टवानहम्। न मोघः सायकः कश्चित् सात्यकेरभवत् प्रभो॥
en: 0 king, I then beheld an extremcly wonderful sight there, inasmuch as, O lord, I saw not one shaft of Satyaki fail in striking its aim.

sa: द्रोणस्य सोमकैः सार्धं संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः॥ ते तु सर्वे प्रयत्नेन भारद्वाजं जिघांसवः।
en: A fierce battle between Drona and the Somakas commenced, capable making the hair to stand erect. Then putting forth all their energies slaughtering the of Bharadvaja.

sa: शरजालावृते व्योम्नि न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। स भीमं छादयन् बाणैः सूतपुत्रः पृथग्विधैः॥
en: The welkin being shrouded in that net-work of arrows, nothing could be then distinguished. Then the son of Suta covering Bhima with arrows of various descriptions.

sa: मन्त्राभिपूतस्य महाध्वरेषु। यशखिनो भूरिसहस्रदस्य चा मुनेरिवारण्यगतस्य तस्या न तत्र कश्चिद् वधमभ्यनन्दत॥
en: Nobody present there countenanced the slaughter of Somadatta's illustrious son, who resembled an hermit of the woods and who had given away thousands of golden coins.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोररूपे सुदारुणे। व्यषीदत् कौरवी सेना भिन्ना नौरिव सागरे॥
en: In that-onset the Kuru army became divested of its strength and unable to stand any longer like a ship foundered on the bosom of the ocean.

sa: निरर्थकम्। राजनीतिं व्यपाश्रित्य प्रहिताश्चैव काननम्। यत्नेन च कृतं तत्तद् दैवेन विनिपातितम्॥
en: In pursuance of state policy they were exiled to the forest; though we did all these with the utmost care, they have been frustrated by fate.

sa: नैव नाम तव प्रीत व नाम कृतज्ञता॥ यतस्तवं पुरुषव्याघ्र मामेवाद्य जिघांससि।
en: O mightiest of men, neither have you any feeling nor do you cherish any sense of gratitude when today you are ready even to slay me.

sa: इति शल्यवचः श्रुत्वा राधेयः पृथिवीपते॥ दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं चैव भीमग्रस्तं महाहवे। राजगृद्धी भृशं चैव शल्यवाक्यप्रचोदितः॥ अजातशत्रुमुत्सृज्य माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। तव पुत्रं परित्रातुमभ्यधावत वीर्यवान्।॥
en: Hearing the words of the king Shalya and seeing Duryodhana overpowered by Bhima in that great battle, Karna, worked up with the words of Shalya and anxious to save the king, left the king Yudhishthira who has no enemies and the two sons of Madri and hurried on for rescuing your son.

sa: स कथं भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं राजान् धर्मकोविदम्। हन्याद् भवान् नरश्रेष्ठ प्राकृतोऽन्यः पुमानिव॥
en: O best of men, how could you then like an ordinary man wish to slay your eldest brother the king, who is well versed in morality.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय रुक्मबद्धं नवं दृढम्। तूणादाकृष्य विमलं भल्लं पीतं शितं दृढम्॥
en: He (then) taking up another new and strong bow, plaited with gold and taking out of his quiver a shinning, well-tempered, strong, keen and broad-headed dart.

sa: अभ्यभाषतं संक्रुद्धो द्रौणि परपुरंजयः। तिष्ठ तिष्ठाय ब्रह्मघ्न न मे जीवन् विमोक्ष्यसे।॥
en: Drouni, the victor of hostile cities, said to him, in anger, "Wait, wait! O slayer of Brahmanas, you will not escape me today with your life.

sa: न च केन च धर्मेण विरुध्यन्ते प्रजा इमाः। सर्व हि तेऽब्रुवन् धर्मं यदुक्तं वेदपारगैः॥
en: But I have never seen a country where all the people are irreligious, All the races I have met with recognise as religion what has been declared by persons conversant with the Vedas.

sa: गर्जित्वा सूतपुत्र त्वं शारदाभ्रमिवाफलम्। निष्फलो दृश्यसे कर्ण तब राजा न बुध्यते॥
en: By roaring like the rainless autumnal clouds, O charioteer's son, O Karna, you show that you have no worth. But the king does not understand this.

sa: न भीममुखसम्प्राप्तो मुच्येदिति मतिर्मम। न पार्था हि पञ्चाला न च केशवसात्यकी॥
en: But it is not possible for one to fly from the presence of the enraged Bhima. Indeed neither Arjuna, nor the Panchalas, nor Keshava, nor Satyaki.

sa: एतमर्थमहं ज्ञात्वा ततो गर्जामि गौतम॥ त्वं तु विप्रश्च वृद्धश्च अशक्तश्चापि संयुगे।
en: Well aware of this (to be certain) I give forth (these) roar. O Goutama, you are much advanced in years, a Brahmana and unskillful in battle.

sa: हन्यमानमपश्यंश्च निश्चेष्टं स्म पराक्रमे। अयुतं तत्र योधानां हत्वा पाण्डुसुतो रणे॥ व्यभ्राजत महाराज विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्।
en: Beholding that slaughter all of them were petrified and could not display their prowess. Having killed ten thousand warriors in that battle the son of Pandu shone like the blazing fire without smoke.

sa: तस्य मे वृष्णिवीरस्य ब्रूहि युद्धं यथातथम्। धनंजयार्थे यत्तस्य कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: Tell me of the feats of that Vrishnipero, as he achieved them, struggling to help Dhananjaya in battle. O Sanjaya, you are an expert in narration.

sa: यदि तावन्मया द्रोणो निहतो ब्राह्मणब्रुवः॥ त्वामिदानीं कथं युद्धे न हनिष्यामि विक्रमात्।
en: If Drona, who was a Brahmana in name, could have been killed by me, why should I not, by my power, kill you today in battle.

sa: कर्णस्य मतमास्थाय पुत्रस्ते प्राह सौबलम्। यथेन्द्रः समरे राजन् प्राह विष्णुं यशस्विनम्॥
en: Knowing this to be the opinion O, Karna, your son addressed Subala's son even as the highly illustrious Indra addressed Vishnu, on the field of battle.

sa: द्रवतामथ तेषां तु नान्योऽस्ति युधि मानवः। भयहा यो भवेद् वीरस्त्वामृते सूतनन्दन॥
en: O mighty warrior, O Suta's son, you are the only man in this field who can bring relief and assurance into the hearts of flying chiefs.

sa: सा पाण्डवेन प्रहिता बाह्रीकस्य शिरोऽहरत्॥ स पपात हतः पृथ्व्यां वज्राहत इवाद्रिराट्।
en: That (mace) hurled by the Pandava (Bhimasena) smashed the head of Valhika. He (then) fell down dead on the earth like a tree struck by lightning.

sa: स भित्त्वा तु शरो राजन् पाञ्चालकुलनन्दनम्। अभ्यगाद् धरणीं तूर्णं लोहितार्दो ज्वलन्निव॥
en: O king, then that shaft penetrating through the scion of the Panchala dynasty entered the earth, steeped in blood and burning like a flame of fire.

sa: उदीच्या दाक्षिात्याश्च ये चान्येऽपि महारथाः। ये च कर्णमुखा राजन् रथोदाराः प्रकीर्तिताः॥
en: The Northerners, the Southerners and all cther mighty car-warriors and O king, they that are headed by Karna and are regarded to be most excellent warriors.

sa: अद्य दास्यामि संग्रामं सूतपुत्राय तं निशि। यं जनाः सम्प्रवक्ष्यन्ति यावद् भूमिर्धरिष्यति॥
en: This night, I shall fight such a fierce battle with the son of Suta, of which men will talk as long as the earth will exit.

sa: संजय उवाच भीमसेनस्तु राधेयमुत्सृज्य रथिनां वरम्। इयेष गन्तुं यत्रास्तां वीरौ कृष्णधनंजयौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Abandoning then that foremost of carwarriors namely, the son of Radha, Bhimasena strove to reach the spot where the heroic Krishna and Dhananjaya were.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच आचक्ष्व भगवन्नेतद् यथा विन्दाम्यहं तथा। बलाकस्यानुसम्बन्धं नदीनां कौशिकस्य च॥
en: Arjuna said Tell me of it, O holy one, in a way that I may learn it these stories about Balaka and Kaushika on the river-bank.

sa: पूर्व भगवता प्रोक्तं कृष्णयोर्विजयो ध्रुवः॥ तत् तथास्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु प्रसीद भगवन् मम।
en: O sacred one, you have said before that the two Krishnas are sure to gain victory, he then pleased and let that be the case now.

sa: ततः प्रशीर्णे धनुषि शक्त्या शक्तिमतां वरः॥ जधान दक्षिण बाहुं सात्यकिः कृतवर्मणः।
en: Thereat that foremost of all creatures endued with prowess, viz., Satyaki, seeing his bow cut asunder, wounded the right arm of Kritavarman with an excellent lance.

sa: कर्णं च दशभिर्विद्ध्वा वृषसेनं त्रिभिस्तथा। शल्यस्य सशरं चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद वीर्यवान्॥
en: Piercing then Karna with ten and Vrishasena with three arrows, that highly puissant hero, cut-off Shalya's bow with arrows fixed on the string, near the grasp.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहु डिम्बिर्वरवीरहा। अभ्ययात् तुमुले कर्णं तव सैनयं विभीषयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, that slayer of hostile heroes namely the mighty-armed son of Hidimba, dashed against Karna, in that fierce fight, frightening your troops.

sa: संध्यां धृतिं च मेधां च स्थिति संनतिमेव च। ग्रहनक्षत्रताराभिश्चर्म चित्रं नभस्तलम्॥
en: The Dhriti the Medha, the Sthiti and the Sannati and the firinament, covered over with the planets, constellations and stars, were made its variegated leathern covers.

sa: संजय उवाच तं तथेत्यब्रवीत् पार्थः कृत्यरूपमिदं मम। सर्वमन्यदनात्य गच्छ यत्र सुयोधनः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to, Pritha's son answered him saying-"Let it be so. Even this will I do. Unmindful of anything else, drive where Duryodhana stands.

sa: स कथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठः कर्णः पार्थेन संयुगे। निहतः पुरुष व्याघ्रः प्रसह्यासह्यविक्रमः॥
en: How could Karna, that foremost of carwarriors, that powerful hero, that one of mighty prowess, was slain in battle by force by the son of Pritha?

sa: तान् सूदयित्वाहमपास्य कर्ण दुष्टुं भवन्तं त्वतयाभियातः। सर्वेपञ्चाला झुद्विजन्ते स्म कर्णं दृष्ट्वा गाव: केसरिणं यथैव॥
en: Seeing Karna, the Panchalas are all filled with fright even like the kine on seeing a lion. Like men entering into the gaping jaws of Death the Prabhadrakas, O king, have confronted Karna.

sa: वध्यतां तत्र शूराणां क्रोशतां च परस्परम्॥ घोरमायोधनं जज्ञे पशूनां वैशसं यथा।
en: On account of those combatants striking one another and shouting at the top of their voices, the battle-field became awful, resembling the slaughter ground of creatures.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे कर्णः पीडितो दृढधन्वना। वेगं चक्रे मगवेगो भीमसेनस्थं प्रति॥
en: Inflamed with rage in consequence of his being pierced thus by the firm bowmen Bhima, Karna endued with great acitivy, dashed against the car of Bhimasena.

sa: वस्तानि सर्वभूतानि त्रैलोक्यं भूः प्रकम्पते। निमित्तानि च घोराणि तत्र संदधत: शरम्॥
en: All the creatures were filled with terror; and the three worlds began to tremble. And while he was aiming that shaft, numerous dreadful omens appeared there.

sa: भवान् मातृसमोऽस्माकं तथा पितृसमोऽपि च॥ गतिश्च परमा कृष्ण त्वमेव च परायणम्।
en: You are like both a mother and a father to us. You, O Krishna, are our sanctuary; that is why your words are beneficial to us.

sa: संजय उवाच तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य सात्वकं युद्धदुर्मदम्। क्रोधाद् भूरिश्रवा राजन् सहसा समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding that warrior indomitable in battle, that scion of the Sini race rush furiously to battle, o king, Bhurisravas, inflamed with wrath, assailed him.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसां तव पुत्रं महारथम्। धर्मराजो द्रुतं विद्ध्वा तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira, the righteous, after having quickly penetrated your son, that mighty car-warrior, who was all on a sudden proceeding against him, addressed him, saying-wait, wait.

sa: स मोघं कृतमात्मानं दृष्ट्वा पार्थेन कौरवः। उत्सृज्य सात्यकि क्रोधाद् गर्हयामास पाण्डवम्॥
en: Then that descendant of the Kuru race, beholding himself incapacitated by Pritha's son, began, out of rage, to reprove the son of Pandu, having abandoned Satyaki.

sa: द्रोणे चित्रास्रता संख्ये राजंस्तवमनुचिन्तय। आचार्यो हि भृशं राजन् निग्रहे तव गृध्यति॥
en: Think also of Drona, of the wonderful knowledge of weapons he will display in battle; O king, the preceptor earnestly longs to capture you in battle.

sa: द्रोणस्तु तद् वचः श्रुत्वा पुत्रस्य तव दुर्मनाः। मुहूर्तमिव तद् ध्यात्वा भृशमार्तोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Drona too, hearing those words of your son, became sad at heart. Then, O king of kings, reflecting a moment he said very sorrowfully (these words).

sa: निन्ये च चतुरो वाहान् यमस्य सदनं प्रति। ततो रथादवप्लुत्य सौबलो भरतर्षभ॥
en: And dispatched the latter's four steeds to the kingdom of Death. Thereupon, O foremost of the Bharatas, jumping down from his chariot, the son of Subala.

sa: तत: कुलिन्देषु हतेषु तेष्वथ प्रहृष्टरूपास्तव ते महारथाः। भृशं प्रदध्मुलवणाम्बुसम्भवान् परांश्च बाणासनपाणयोऽभ्ययुः॥
en: Those powerful car-warriors of our army being glad at the fall of the Kulindas blew their sea conchs and with bows in hand attacked their enemies.

sa: राशंश्च धार्तराष्ट्रस्य कार्यं सुमहदुद्यतम्। मयि तचाहितं शल्य तेन जीवसि मे क्षणम्॥
en: A great work is now to be done for the king Dhritarashtra. This work depends on me, O Shalya and therefore you live for a moment,

sa: दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनौ कृष्णौ सात्वतं चैव सात्यकिम्। संविदं चैव कुर्यास्त्वं सिंहनादेन पाण्डव॥
en: Beholding Krishna and Arjuna and the Satvata hero Satyaki sound and alive, inform me of the fact, O son of Pandu, by uttering your war-cry aloud.

sa: तां ते सेना समालोड्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः। विक्षोभयित्वा च पुनः कर्णं समभिदुदुवुः॥
en: Those warriors, belonging to the side of the son of Pandu, after having first agitated that army and again having afflicted, proceeded most rapidly against Karna.

sa: संजय उवाच श्रुतकर्मा ततो राजंश्चित्रसेनं महीपतिम्। आजध्ने समरे क्रुद्धः पश्चाशद्भिः शिलीमुखैः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon, O monarch, the wrathful Shrutakarman had slain down Chitrasena, the lord of the earth, in the battle, by means of fifty different arrows.

sa: विस्थः स गृहीत्वा तु खङ्गं खगभृतां वर। द्रोणमभ्यपतद् राजन् वैनतेय इवोरगम्॥
en: Then that foremost of sword-men, deprived took up his sword and rushed upon Drona, O king, like Vinata swooping down of his car, upon a snake.

sa: हन्त शल्य विजानीहि हन्त भूयो ब्रवीमि ते। कल्माषपादः सरसि निमजन् राक्षसोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: You should know all this, O Shalya, I will speak again to you. A Rakshasa by the name of Kamalashapada, while bathing in a tank said.

sa: अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुर्योधव्रतमनुष्ठिताः। न हि ते समरं चक्रः पृष्ठतो वै कथञ्चन॥
en: Indeed, those heroes, strictly observed the vow of warriors and slaughtered each other in the battle; but they not at all fought from each other's back.

sa: तस्यास्यतस्तान् निशितान् पीतधारान् द्रौणे: शरान् पृष्ठतश्चाग्रतश्चा धरा वियद् द्यौः प्रदिशो दिशश्च च्छन्ना बाणैरभवन् घोररूपैः॥
en: Then as Drona's son shot his welltempered, well-sharpened arrows, the earth, the welkin, the firmament, the cardinal and subsidiary quarters, all in his front and rear became covered with arrows of dreadful look.

sa: स रोषान्निःश्वसन् राजन् निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा॥ द्रौणि ह्यपश्यत् संग्रामे फाल्गुनं च मुहर्मुहुः।
en: With inflamed eyes and swelling breath, frequently he cast his eyes towards. Ashvatthama and Phalguna, devouring them, as it were, with the fury of his fire.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः क्रुद्धः प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः॥ सारथिं चोदयामास याहि यत्र सुयोधनः।
en: Thereupon Yudhishthira, being filled with wrath and resembling an infuriate elephant, urged his charioteer, asking him to proceed to the place, where Suyodhana took his stand.

sa: तानब्रवीत् पुनर्देवो मत्तः श्रेष्ठतरो हि यः। तं सारथिं कुरुवं मे स्वयं संचिन्त्य मा चिरम्॥
en: Then the God, again, replied them (the celestials), saying, “Having meditated upon the matter yourselves, without the least hesitation, do you appoint him as my charioteer, who will prove himself superior to myself.”

sa: एवंगतोऽपि शक्योऽयं हन्तुं नान्येन केनचित्। ऋते त्वां पुरुषव्याघ्र शये सत्येन चानघ॥
en: But though deprived of that dart, I swear to you, O sinless one, that hero could not still be defeated by any one else save yourself.

sa: क्रुद्धौ तौ तु नरव्याघ्रौ वेगवन्तौ बभूवतुः॥ तलशब्देन रुषितौ यथा नागौ महावने।
en: Those two enraged heroes of tigerish fierceness grew extremely violent in their moments like two elephants excited at the claps of hunters in a deep forest.

sa: नवाद सुमहानादं बलवान् सूतनन्दनः। तं च नादं ततः श्रुत्वा पुत्रास्ते हर्षिताऽभवन्॥
en: That puissant descendant of a charioteer's race, uttered a loud roar; and then your sons hearing that loud shout uttered by Karna, became filled with delight.

sa: जानीषे हि रणे द्रोणं रभसं श्रे. पम्मतम्। प्रतिज्ञा चापि ते नित्यं श्रुता द्रोणस्य माधव॥
en: You know how formidable Drona is in battle, Drona who is regarded as the foremost of the Kuru warriors. You also know the vow he made before the eyes of all, O master.

sa: रक्ष्यते शक्तिरेषा हि रौद्रं रूपं बिभर्ति च। घटोत्कचस्तु राधेयं प्रत्युद्यातु महाबलः॥
en: He preserves that Sakti; and therefore he has now assumed a terrible aspect. Ghatotkacha, is ever attached to your interests and is anxious for your welfare.

sa: द्वावेव किल वृष्णीनां तत्र ख्यातौ महारथौ। प्रद्युम्नश्च महाबाहुस्त्वं चैव युधि सात्वत॥
en: O Satvata, it is said that among the Vrishnis there are two principal and mighty car-warriors in battle, namely, the highly highly energetic Pradyumna and yourself.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज सात्वतो युद्धदुर्मदः। धनुरन्त्यत् समादाय सज्यं कृत्वा च संयुगे।॥ क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन अनुविन्दशिरोऽहरत्।
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, wrathful Satvata, most invincible in the field, having taken up another bow and stretched its string properly, severed the head of Anuvinda with an arrow, sharp like the razor.

sa: दिष्ट्या विनिर्जिताः संख्ये पृथिव्यां सर्वपार्थिवाः॥५५ युवां विजयिनौ चापि दिष्ट्या पश्यामि संयुगे।
en: It is the time to laugh in exhilaration as all kings defeated in battle and I am seeing both of you as conqueror in this battle-field.

sa: अमर्षजं निकृतिमसीरणेरितं हृदिस्थितं ज्वलनमिमं सदा मम। हतोमया सोऽद्य समेत्य कर्ण इति ब्रुवन् प्रशमयसेऽद्य फाल्गुन॥
en: O Phalguna, that you have met with and slain that Karna in battle and thereby quench the flame of vindictiveness blazing within my heart being fanned by the wind of mortification. Assure me,

sa: क्व सम्प्रति महाबाहो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। अकृतव्रण शक्यो वै दुष्टुं वेदविदां वरः॥
en: “Where can I see at present the mighty son of Jamadagni, O you of long arms, 0 Akritavrana, that foremost among those conversant with the Vedas.

sa: स राजपुत्रोऽन्यदवाय कार्मुकं वृकोदरं द्वादशभिः पराभिनत्। स्वयं नियच्छंस्तुरगानजिह्मगैः शरैश्च भीमं पुनरष्यवीवृषत्॥
en: Prince Dushasana, taking up another bow, hit Bhima with twelve arrows and taking hold of the reins of his horses rained upon Bhima hosts of shafts.

sa: शूद्राणामथ यो भुङ्क्ते स भुङ्क्ते पृथिवीमलम्। मलं नृणां स पिबति मलं भुङ्क्ते जनस्य च॥
en: But the man who accepts food from a Shudra, swallows the very abomination of the Earth and drinks the excretions of the human body, and partakes of the filth of all the world.

sa: बुद्धिलाभात् तु पुरुषः सर्वं तुदति किल्बिषम्। विपाप्मा लभते सत्त्वं सत्त्वस्थः सम्प्रसीदति॥
en: A person wins a keen understanding, succeeds in dissipating all his sins. A sinless person acquires the quality of Goodness, and having acquired it becomes cheerful.

sa: तत् ते वर्षं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथायथमरिन्दम। शृणु मे गदतो राजन् यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥ महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमानृक्षवानपि। विध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तैते कुलपर्वताः॥ तेषां सहस्रशो राजन् पर्वतास्ते समीपतः। अविज्ञाताः सारवन्तो विपुलाचित्रसानवः॥
en: O king, hear as I speak of what you have asked me. Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Shuktimat, Gandhamadana, Vindhya, and Paripatra, these are the seven main mountains forming the boundaries (of Bharata Varsha). Besides these there are 0 king, thousands of other mountains which are hard and huge and which contain many excellent valleys. Besides these (large ones) there are many smaller mountains inhabited by the barbarians.

sa: ततो रोषार्दितो जिष्णुः प्रमृत्य रुधिरं करात्। धनुरादत्त तद् दिव्यं शरवर्ववर्ष च॥
en: At this, Jishnu, worked up with rage wiped the blood from his hand and once more taking up his bow, showered a perfect downpour of arrows.

sa: धान्यं श्रमेणार्जितवित्तसंचितं विप्रे सुशीले च प्रयच्छते यः। वसुन्धरा तस्य भवेत् सुतुष्टा धारां वसूनां प्रतिमुञ्चतीव॥
en: Earth is always satisfied with that man who gives rice and wealth earned by his own labour to the Brahmanas whose behaviour is good. She pours upon such a man showers of wealth.

sa: को हर्जुनस्य सान्निध्ये शक्तोऽभ्येतुं युधिष्ठिरम्। सर्वभूतानि यो ह्येकः खाण्डवे जितवान् पुरा। कस्तमन्यस्तु राधेयात् प्रतियुद्ध्येजिजीविषुः॥
en: Who could successfully assail Yudhishthira before Arjuna? Who else except the son of Radha, who wishes to keep his life, would fight with Arjuna who had defeated single-handed formerly all creatures at Khandava?

sa: एवं भानुमयं ह्यन्नं भूतानां प्राणधारणम्। पितैष सर्वभूतानां तस्मात् तं शरणं व्रज॥
en: Thus the food which supports the lives of creatures is the sun and therefore he is the father of all creatures. Therefore take shelter in him.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं रामः संतापमोहितः। अब्रवीद् दुष्कृतं सौम्य तां विना त्वमिहागतः॥
en: When Saumitri had spoken thus, Rāma transported by grief; said to Laksmana, O gentle one, you have done wrong in having come out hither without her.

sa: कर्णस्य मतमास्थाय सौबलस्य च यत् पुरा। अचिन्त्य पाण्डवान् कामाद् यथेष्टं कृतवानसि॥
en: Acting upon the counsel of Karna and the son of Subala, and thoroughly disregarding the Pandavas, you formerly treated the latter as it had pleased you.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रो महाराजः पिता मे दैवतं परम्। शासनेऽस्य प्रिये चैव स्थेयं मत्प्रियकाक्षिभिः॥
en: King Dhritarashtra, however, is our father and god. If you wish to do what is pleasing to me, always obey him and do what he likes.

sa: तत्रोपनिषदं चैव परिशेषं च पार्थिव। मध्नामि मनसा तात दृष्ट्वा चान्वीक्षिकी पराम्॥
en: Keeping in view the high science of inferential ratioscination, I churned with my mind, O Monarch, the Upanishads and the supplementary works relating to the Vedas.

sa: यदवप्लुत्य जग्राह देवसृष्टां महाशनिम्॥ एवं कृत्वा रणे कर्ण आरुरोह रथं पुनः।
en: Inasmuch as he succeeded in grasping the Asani of celestial make, having jumped down from his car. Having achieved this feat, Karna again ascended his car.

sa: कथं हि शिरसो मध्ये कृतं तेन पदं मम। मर्षयिष्यामि गोविन्द पादस्पर्शमिवोरगः॥
en: He has placed his foot on my head. O Govinda, how shall I bear it, (shall I not resent it) like a snake trodden by foot?

sa: तत्र किं प्राप्तकालं नः प्रणिपातः पलायनम्। प्राणान् वा सम्परित्यज्य प्रतियुध्यामहे परान्॥
en: When the time comes, what should we do? Surrender or fly or shall we fight against the enemies and give up (all hopes of) our lives.

sa: अयं मेषः सवृषणः शक्रो ह्यवृषणः कृतः। मेषस्य वृषणौ गृह्य शक्रायाशु प्रयच्छत॥
en: This ram is possessed of a scrotum; while Śakra has been deprived of his. Do you taking the scrotum of the ram furnish Sakra with it.

sa: इति ते वै द्विजाः श्रुत्वा तस्य दुष्टस्य रक्षसः। विव्यथुश्चुक्रुशुश्चैव तस्य वाक्यप्रधर्षिताः॥
