en: 'Hearing these words of that wicked Rakshasa, the Brahmanas there were greatly moved. Cut to the quick by that speech, they set up a loud uproar.

sa: कथं चाराजकं राष्ट्र शक्यं धारयितुं प्रभो। तस्माद् गर्भ समाधत्स्व भीष्मः संवर्धयिष्यति॥
en: O Lord, how can a kingdom be protected without a king? Therefore, see that the ladies conceive. Bhishma will watch over the children in their womb.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच लब्ध्वा वरं तु कौन्तेयो जलादुत्तीर्यधर्मवित्। जचाद पादौधौम्यस्य भ्रातुंश्च परिषस्वजे॥
en: The virtuous son of Kunti (Yudhishthira), having obtained the boon, rose from the water. He then took hold of Dhaúmya's feet and then embraced his brothers.

sa: सुखं हि कारणं श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर। आनन्तर्याद् विधास्यामि सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्॥
en: Having learnt the cause of your hostility, and ascertained your strength and weakness, I will, O monkey, understanding the irritation that has ensued, compass your happiness.

sa: जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धं प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय। हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः॥
en: O gentle one, do you satisfy your promise of slaying me without any hesitation. O Kakuthstha, those, who cannot carry out their promises, repair to hell.

sa: निःशब्दे च स्थिते तत्र ततो विप्रजने पुनः। राजानं ब्राह्मणच्छद्या चार्वाको राक्षसोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Some time after, when the Brahmanas had become silent, a Rakshasa of the name of Charvaka, who had disguised himself as a Brahmana, addressed the king.

sa: तत इष्टिं चकारर्षिस्तस्य वै पुत्रकामिकीम्। अथास्य तनयो जज्ञे प्रतर्दन इति श्रुतः॥
en: After this, the Rishi performed a sacrifice with the object of bestowing a Divodasa. As the result thereof, to Divodasa was born a son named Pratarddana.

sa: एते महामृगा वीर मामीक्षन्ते पुनः पुनः॥ वक्तुकामा इह हि मे इङ्गितान्युपलक्षये।
en: Behold, O hero, the high deer have been casting their looks again and again at men; methinks from their gestures, they intend speaking something to me.

sa: संजय उवाच सर्वथा विरथः कर्णः पुनर्भीमेन निर्जितः। रथमन्यं समास्थाय पुनर्विव्याध पाण्डवम्॥
en: Sanjaya said. Thus though deprived of his car and completely vanquished by Bhima, Karna mounting on another car began speedily to pierce the son of Pandu.

sa: अप्रमाणा प्रसूतिर्मे शीलतः क्रियते कुलम्। प्रार्थयामि च तत्कर्म येन विस्तीर्यते यशः॥
en: My birth has been low. It is conduct, however, which determines the birth. I wish to act in such a way that my fame may spread.

sa: तान्यायुधान्यद्भुतविग्राहणि मोघानि कृत्वा स शरोऽग्निदीपः। प्रगृह्य तस्यैव किरीटजुष्टं तदातिकायस्य शिरो जहार॥
en: But beating down all those weapons of wonderful forms, that arrow alive with flames, coming to the diadem-decked head of Atikāya, severed the same (in twain).

sa: विरक्तराष्ट्राश्च वयं मित्राणि कुपितानि नः। धिक्कृताः पार्थिवैः सर्वैः स्वजनेन च सर्वशः॥
en: On their being dispossessed of their kingdom, our friends are angry with us; and we are reviled by all the kings and by all our kinsmen.

sa: शराहतेनैव तदातया गिरा स्वरं ममालम्ब्य सुदूरसुश्रवम्। उपाहृतं तद् वचनं सुदारुणं त्वमागतो येन विहाय मैथिलीम्॥
en: Wounded by my shaft, he, assuming my voice, and in accents capable of being heard from far, uttered those dreadful words fraught with dole, hearing which, you have come hither, renouncing Mithilā's daughter.

sa: किं मे भ्रातृविहीनस्य स्वर्गेण सुरसत्तमाः। यत्र ते मम स स्वर्गो नायं स्वर्गो मतो मम॥
en: O foremost of the deities, what is Heaven to me if I am separated from my brothers? That is Heaven where those brothers of mine are. This in my opinion, is not Heaven.

sa: मुक्तानां तु गतिर्ब्रह्मन् क्षेत्रज्ञ इति कल्पिता। स हि सर्वगुणश्चैव निर्गुणश्चैव कथ्यते॥
en: The ultimate end of the Liberated is called by the name of Kshetrajna. He is considered as both possessed of, and freed from, all the attributes.

sa: नायं मया शरः पूर्व रावणस्य वधार्थिना। मुक्तः शत्रुघ्न भूतानां महान्हासो भवेदिति॥
en: When, O Satrughna, formerly I sought to slay Råvaņa, I did not discharge this arrow, thinking that if discharged, it would inflict great havoc on creatures.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं सान्त्वेन दानेन भेदैर्दण्डेन वा पुनः॥ अमित्रः शक्यते हन्तुं तन्मे ब्रूहि यथातथम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said : Tell me in detail how can a foe be destroyed by the arts of conciliation, or the expenditure of money or by producing disunion or by the employment of force.

sa: तत्समानो भवास्माभिर्भोज्यं दास्यामहे वयम्। भुक्षव शौचं परित्यज्य यद्धि भुक्तं सदास्तु ते॥
en: Be you like us! All of us will give you food, Eat that which ought always to be your food, leaving of such purity of conduct!

sa: शक्र उवाच तव पुत्रसहस्रेषु पीड्यमानेषु शोभने। किं कृपायितवत्यत्र पुत्र एकत्र हन्यति॥
en: Indra said: O handsome one, thousands of your sons are oppressed (all over the world), why do you then grieve for one who is under inflictions?

sa: दृश्यते ज्ञानयोगेन आवां च प्रसृतौ ततः। एवं ज्ञात्वा तमात्मानं पूजयावः सनातनम्॥
en: He can be apprehended by knowledge alone. We two have originated from Him. Knowing him in that way, we worship that eternal soul of all things.

sa: किं नु ते तत्र वक्ष्यन्ति सचिवेषु सुहृत्सु च। अयुध्यमानं धर्मज्ञमेकं हत्वानपत्रपाः॥
en: How can those shameless men speak of their (shameful) deed to their friends and relatives that they have killed virtuous man who was averse to fight.

sa: बभूवाथ परित्रस्तो राक्षसो विमुखोऽभवत्। सिंहनादं च ते चक्रुः प्रहृष्टा वनगोचराः।। मारुतिं पूजयांचक्रुर्दृष्ट्वा शूलं तथागतम्॥
en: The Rākşasa was seized with fear and turned away (from the field.) And the monkeys excessively delighted, set up loud shouts, and finding the dart broken, poured forth thanks to the Wind-god's son.

sa: भवान् क्षत्ता च वाप्याचार्यो वा पितामहः। मामेव परिगर्हन्ते नान्यं कंचन पार्थिवम्॥
en: You and Kshattri and the king, and the preceptor and the grandfather all find fault with me and not with any other king of the earth.

sa: कुतो ह्यस्य ध्रुवः स्वर्गः कुतो नैःश्रेयसं परम्। विधिना केन जुहुयाद् दैव पित्र्यं तथैव च॥
en: Whence can he surely acquire heaven and whence that which is of the highest benefit? According to what ordinances should he perform the Homa in honour of the gods and the departed manes?

sa: दिष्ट्या च भगवान् स्थाणुर्देव्या सह परंतप। साक्षाद् दृष्टः स्वयुद्धेन तोषितश्च त्वयानघ॥
en: And luckily, O tormentor of foes, O sinless being, you have beheld that very god, Sthanu himself, together with the goddess and pleased them by fighting

sa: भ्रातृव्या बलिनो यस्मात् पाण्डुपुत्रा नराधिप। पश्चात्तापो यथा न स्यात् तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥
en: O king, the sons of Pandu are stronger than their cousins (your sons). O chastiser of foes, I tell you plainly what you ought to do.

sa: ते वयं साधु पञ्चालान् गच्छाम यदि मन्यसे। अपूर्वदर्शनं वीर रमणीयं भविष्यति॥
en: O blessed one, if you wish to go to Panchala, let us go there. O hero, we have not seen it before it must be beautiful.

sa: ततस्तु क्रुद्ध सुबलस्य पुत्रो माद्रीसुतं सहदेवं विमर्दे। प्रासेन जाम्बूनदभूषणेन जिघांसुरेकोऽभिपपात शीघ्रम्॥
en: Filled with anger the son of Subala, then single-handed, rushed, impetuously against Sahadeva in that encounter, desirous of killing the latter with lance adorned with gold.

sa: अभिदुग्धाः परे चेन्नो न भेतव्यं परंतप। असमर्थाः परे जेतुमस्मान् युधि समास्थितान्॥
en: The enemies ready to fight need not be feared, 0 subduer of foes; for the foes when in the battle field are incapable of conquering us.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा प्रययुर्हि शीघ्रं तान्येच वान्यनुवर्तमानाः। मुहुर्महालवदुच्छ्वसन्तो ज्यां विक्षिपन्तश्च महाधनुर्यः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Saying this, they speedily went, wending the way pointed out to them, sighing hot and hard like snakes and twanging their large bows,

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा समासीनं विसंज्ञमिव कौरवम्। आर्ति राजागमत् तीव्रां कौन्तेयः परवीरहा॥
en: Seeing him thus seated like one shom of consciousness, that destroyer of hostile heroes, viz., the royal son of Kunti, became penetrated by a piercing grief.

sa: यत्ते भिन्नं च दग्धं य यच्च किंचिद् विनाशितम्। सर्वं तथैव द्रष्टासि विशिष्टं वा जनार्दन॥
en: Whatever articles of yours have been broken or burnt or otherwise destroyed (by me). you will see restored, O Janardana, to their former state or they will reappear even in a better forin.

sa: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निवृतं नः प्रयोजनम्। क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव ॥
en: With death our enmity has terminated and our object has been accomplished: he is as dear to me as to you: perform (therefore) his funeral rites.

sa: त्वं नैते ह्यनुरञ्जेयुः प्रत्यक्षं प्रवदामि ते। यथाऽयं जाम्बवान् नीलः सुहोत्रश्च महाकपिः॥ नाहं ते इमे सर्वे सामदानादिभिर्गुणैः। दण्डेन न त्वया शक्याः सुग्रीवादपकर्षितुम् ॥
en: They shall never take to you. This I tell you in presence of all. And I will tell you what. You neither by the virtues of conciliation, charity and the rest, nor by chastisement, shall succeed in drawing to your side this Jāmbavān, or Nīla, or the mighty ape Suhotra, or myself.

sa: वयस्य इति कृत्वा च विस्रब्धः प्रवदाम्यहम्। दुःखमन्तर्गतं तन्मे मनो हरति नित्यशः॥
en: Having made you my friend, I inspired with confidence am unbosoming myself to you. The sorrow, that is in my heart, is constantly enfeebling my mind.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नास्मै देयो ह्यनुनयो नायमर्हति सान्त्वनम्। लोकवृद्धतमे कृष्णे योऽर्हणां नाभिमन्यते॥
en: Bhishma said He, who does not approve of the worship offered to Krishna, who is the oldest in the universe, deserves neither soft words nor conciliation.

sa: व्यश्वनागरथान् दृष्ट्वा तत्र वीरान् सहस्रशः। धावमानान् रणे व्यग्रान् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting, beholding the steeds, the chariots, the elephants and thousands of heroic soldiers flying away in haste from the field of battle.

sa: अमृतादुत्थितं ह्येतदुभयं रत्नसम्भवम्। तस्माद् रक्ष्यं त्वया कर्ण जीवितं चेत् प्रियं तव॥
en: These two jewelled ear-rings have derived their origin from ambrosia. Therefore, they should be carefully preserved by you, if you have any love for your life.

sa: यदि दास्यसि कर्ण त्वं सहजे कुण्डले शुभे। आयुषः प्रक्षयं गत्वा मृत्योर्वशमुपैष्यसि॥
en: If, O Karna, you part with those auspicious ear-rings with which you were born, your life will be shortened and you will be subject to death.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे गजवाजिनरक्षये। शकुनिः सौबलो राजन् सहदेवं समभ्ययात्॥
en: Sanjaya said During the course of that battle which was so destructive of men and horses and elephants, Subala's son Shakuni, O king, proceeded against Sahadeva.

sa: न मन्त्रयेयमन्यैस्ते सचिवैः सह कर्हिचित्। नीतिमन्तः परीप्सन्तो वृथा ब्रूयुः परे मयि॥
en: I shall never consult with your other ministers. If I do, for they always seek superiority, they will then impute various kinds of faults to me.

sa: ते चापि सर्वप्रवरा नरेन्द्रा महाबला वर्मिणश्चर्मिणश्चा हर्षान्विता युयुधस्तस्य राजन् समन्ततः पाण्डवयोधवीराः॥
en: The foremost royal fighters of the Pandava host also, endued with great shields fought on delightfully, o king, on all sides (in that battle with Alayudha).

sa: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽवृता। सर्वार्थान् विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी॥
en: Tama Intellect, O Partha, is that by which, being one covered by ignorance, considers wrong to be right, and sees all things in a reverse state.

sa: दिष्ट्या नाहं परावृत्तो वैरात् प्राकृतवन्जितः॥ दिष्ट्या न विमति कांचिद् भजित्वा तु पराजितः। सुप्तं वाथं प्रमत्तं वा यथा हन्याद् विषेण वा॥ एवं व्युत्क्रान्तधर्मेण व्युत्क्रम्य समयं हतः।
en: By good luck, I was not defeated like an ordinary person. By good luck, I have not been defeated after I had done some mean act. Like killing a person who is aslecp or who is heedless, like killing one with poison, my destruction has taken place, for I have been killed unfairly against the rules of fair fight.

sa: ब्राह्मणा ऊचु: एव दुर्योधनसखा चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः। परिव्राजकरूपेण हितं तस्य चिकीर्षति॥
en: This is the Rakshasa Charvaka, the friend of Duryodhana. Having put on the guise of a religious mendicant, he seeks the well-being of his friend Duryodhana.

sa: ततः प्रतिष्ठितो विष्णुः स्वर्गलोके यथा पुरा। येन व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: There upon as before, Visnu, who comprise the three worlds and all objects, mobile and immobile, again established himself as before in the land of immortals.

sa: अत्र कार्य समाधत्स्व प्राप्तकालमरिंदम। स्थाने वा गमने वापि दूरं यातश्च सात्यकिः॥
en: Shall we proceed or stay here? Satyaki has gone far ahead of us." While the charioteer was thus speaking to the son of Bharadvaja, O sire.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच दमयन्ती तु तच्छ्रुत्वा पुण्यश्लोकस्य चेष्टितम्। अमन्यत नलं प्राप्तं कर्मचेष्टाभिसूचितम्॥
en: Brihadashva said : Having heard of those wonderful behaviours of that righteous one and having known him by his acts, Damayanti considered that Nala was obtained.

sa: यतोमूलं नरः पश्येत् प्रादुर्भावमिहात्मनः। कथं तस्मिन् न वर्तेत प्रत्यक्षे सति दैवते॥
en: How can a man disregard him who is god himself seen and felt, and who is looked upon as a cause from whom he has sprung.

sa: स शरः पण्डितं हत्वा विवेश धरणीतलम्। यथा नरं निहत्याशु भुजग: कालचोदितः॥
en: That shaft slaying Panditaka penetrated into the earth, even as a serpent urged by fate, enters the earth having bitten a person whose hour has come.

sa: ततो ययौ वृतो देवैः कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। धर्येण सहितो धीमान् स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: Surrounded by the celestials the Kuru king Yudhishthira then went away from that place. He was accompanied by Dharma, and the great Rishis uttered his praises.

sa: वयं हि ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा मानसाः परिकीर्तिताः। गताः निःश्रेयसार्थं हि कदाचिद् दिशमुत्तराम्॥
en: We are the sons of Brahman, begotten by his will. Once on a time we went to the north for the acquisition of our highest good.

sa: अब्रवीद्धि विशुद्धात्मा नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। स्त्रीपूर्वको ह्यसौ राजस्तस्माद् वयॊ मया रणे॥
en: That pure-souled one had said 'I will not slay Shikhandin; for this one was a female before, O king, so I should avoid him in battie.

sa: मा तात साहसं कार्मिम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। प्रश्नानुक्त्वा यथाकामं पिवस्व च हरस्व च॥
en: "O child, do not venture this. It has been before obtained possession by me. First answer my questions and then drink water and carry it away.”

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच क्व तद् वनं महाप्राज्ञ के वृक्षाः सरितश्च काः। गिरयः पर्वताश्चैव कियत्यध्वनि तद् वनम्॥
en: The wife of the Brahmana said Where is that foremost, O you of great wisdom? What are its trces? What are its rivers? What its mountains and hills? How far is that forest?

sa: व्यास उवाच बीभत्सोर्वचनं सौम्य सत्यमेतद् युधिष्ठिर। शास्त्रदृष्टः परो धर्मः स्थितो गार्हस्थ्यमाश्रितः॥
en: Vyasa said The words of Arjuna, O amiable Yudhishthira, are true. The highest religion as sanctioned by the scriptures, consists in the duties of a householder.

sa: ते हि सर्वे महात्मानश्चत्वारोऽतिरथा भुवि। न शक्या धर्मतो हन्तुं लोकपालैरपि स्वयम्॥
en: Those four were very great warriors and regarded as Atirathas in the world. The very Regents of the Earth could not kill them in fair fight.

sa: संवाससमयो जीर्ण इत्याभाष्य ततस्तु तान्। हिडिम्बा समयं कृत्वा स्वां गतिं प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: Knowing that the period of her stay with the (Pandava) had come to an end, Hidimba making another agreement with them went away wherever she like.

sa: न चाहं त्यक्त कामस्त्वां किमलं भीरु शङ्कसे। त्यजेयमहमात्मानं न चैव त्वामनिन्दिते॥
en: O timid one! why are you afraid? I do not intend to forsake you; O faultless one, I can part with myself, but not with you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच राज्ञः शरीरेण सह मामपीदं कलेवरम्। दग्धव्यं सुप्रतिच्छन्नमेतदार्ये प्रियं कुरु॥
en: Therefore, my body should be burned with that of the king. O revered abater, do not refuse me your permission to what is agreeable to me.

sa: अभिवाद्य च धर्मात्मा रामो भ्राता च लक्ष्मणः। सुग्रीवो वानराश्चैव जग्मुः संहष्टमानसाः॥
en: Having paid homage (to the sacred memory of those great ones) the virtuous-souled Rāma his (younger) brother Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkeys, proceeded with delighted hearts.

sa: इतीदमुक्त्वा शिरसा च पादौ संस्पृश्य कृष्णस्त्वरितो जगाम॥ ततो महान् निनदः प्रादुरासीत् सस्त्रीकुमारस्य पुरस्य तस्य।
en: Having said these words, Krishna touched the feet of his father with his head and quickly left him. Then a loud wail of sorrow arose from the ladies and children of his house,

sa: लक्ष्मणेमां मया सार्धं प्रशाधि त्वं वसुंधराम्। द्वितीयं मेऽन्तरात्मानं त्वामियं श्रीरुपस्थिता ॥
en: O Lakṣmaṇa, do you together with me rule this earth. You are my second self; and this good fortune has taken possession of you (as well).

sa: स्पृष्टमात्रे तदा पाणौ विकुब्जा विगतज्वराः। युक्तं परमया लक्ष्म्या बभौ कन्याशतं तदा॥
en: And as soon as he touched them, the hundred daughters were cured of their crookedness, and became free from anguish, and were endowed with pre-eminent beauty.

sa: त्वदृते देवदेवेश नान्यः शक्तः कथंचन॥ हन्तुं दैत्यान् महादेव जहि तांस्त्वं सुरद्विषः।
en: O Lord of the gods, O supreme Divinity, save yourself, there is none capable of slaying the Daityas. Do you slay those injurers of the gods.

sa: न तु संकालनं राज्ञो विना पुत्रेण मन्त्रिणः। सर्वज्ञाः कर्तुमीषुस्ते ततो रक्षन्ति भूमिपम्॥ तैलद्रोण्यां शायितं तं सचिवैस्तु नराधिपम्। हा मृतोऽयमिति ज्ञात्वा स्त्रियस्ताः पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: But well versed in everything, the counsellors, in the absence of his son, did not perform the funeral obsequies of the king; and therefore they placed his body stretched in the pan of oil. Alas! at length concluding it for certain that the king was dead, the ladies burst out into lamentaions.

sa: ततो निश्चित्य मथनं योक्त्रं कृत्वा च वासुकिम्। मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा ममन्थुरमितौजसः॥
en: Then deciding upon churning (the ocean), those ones of immeasurable energy making Vasuki the cord, and the Mandara (hill), the stick, began to churn the deep.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमुक्तस्ततो राजा व्यासशिष्यः प्रतापवान्। आचचक्षेऽथ यद् वृत्तं तत् सर्वं वेदतत्त्ववित्॥
en: Sauti said Having been thus addressed by the king, the powerful disciple of Vyasa, (Vaishampayana), learned in all the Vedas, narrated every thing as it happened.

sa: अथवा शक्तिमन्तौ तौ सुराणामपि निग्रहे। ममैव तु न दुःखानामस्ति मन्ये विपर्ययः॥
en: Or they are capable of discomfiting the celestials in a battle but me-thinks by my illluck, the end of my miseries has not arrived as yet.

sa: न च तेऽभूत् सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि मन्युर्मनसि पार्थिव। सभार्यस्य नरश्रेष्ठ तेन ते प्रीतिमानहम्॥
en: In your heart, however, O king, the slightest feeling of anger or vexation did not rise. For this, O king, I became highly pleased with you.

sa: पल्वलानि तटाकानि सरांसि सरितस्तथा। नद्योऽनूपवनान्ताश्च दुर्गाश्च धरणीधराः॥ लोलिता वसुधा सर्वा न च पश्यामि जानकीम्।
en: And I have explored pools, and watery expanses, and tanks, and rivers, and streams, and marshes, and and woods, and citadels, and mountains, yea, all this earth; but Janaki I do not fimd.

sa: मध्यं प्राप्तं यथा ग्रीष्मे तपन्तं भास्करं दिवि॥ यथा दैत्यचमूं शक्तस्तापयामास संयुगे।
en: Who then resembled the summer sun scorching the world from the meridian. Just as in the days of yore, Shakra afflicted the hosts of the Daityas,

sa: यस्तं वेत्ति स मां वेत्ति योऽनु तं स हि मामनु॥ रुद्रो नारायणश्चैव सत्त्वमेकं द्विधाकृतम्।
en: He who knows Rudra knows myself, and he who knows myself, knows Rudra. He who follows Rudra follows me. Rudra is Narayana. Both are one; and one is shown in two different forms.

sa: क्षणभूतेव नौ रात्रिः संवृत्तेयं परंतप। इमां चिन्तयतोः सर्वा निखिलेन कथां तव॥
en: And, O afflicter of foes, as we had been reflecting upon all this at length, the night has passed away as if it were as moment.

sa: तथा कृष्णस्य वीर्येण नायुधं विद्यते समम्। येन नागान् पिशाचांश्च निहन्यान्माधवो रणे॥
en: Then there is no weapon suited to Krishna's prowess. He requires weapon like the one with which Mahadeva (Shiva) kills Nagas and Pishachas in the battle.

sa: रावणे सुखसंविष्टे ताः स्त्रियो विविधप्रभाः। ज्वलन्तः काञ्चना दीपाः प्रेक्षन्तो निमिषा इव॥
en: It seemed as if, Rāvana having attained rest (through sleep), the flaming golden lamps furnished with various rays, were gazing at the girls with winkless eyes.

sa: धनुर्मे नास्ति भगवन् बाहुवीर्येण सम्मितम्। कुर्वतः समरे यत्नं वेगं यद् विषहेन्मम॥
en: But, O illustrious one, I have no bow suited to the strength of my arms and capable of bearing the might I put fourth in battle.

sa: लुब्धक उवाच यद्यन्यवशगेनेदं कृतं ते पन्नगाशुभम्। कारणं वै त्वमप्यत्र तस्मात् किल्बिषी॥
en: The fowler said If you have committed this evil, urged thereto by another, the sin is your also as you are an instrument in the act.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्। यत् त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम॥
en: Arjuna said The excellent and mysterious words, relating to the Supreme Self and the individual Self, which you have spoken to me, have removed my delusion.

sa: स युद्ध्वा क्षत्रधर्मेण यथा नान्यः पुमान् क्वचित्।।१९ विवेश सोमं धर्मात्मा कर्मणोऽन्ते महारथः। आविवेश रविं कर्णो निहतः पुरुषर्षभः॥ द्वापरं शकुनिः प्राप धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु पावकम्।
en: Having fought, according to Kshatriya practices, with bravery such as none else had ever been able to show, tat mighty-armed and righteous-souled being entered Soma. Killed on the field of battle, O foremost of men, sons Karna entered the Sun. Shakuni entered into the Dvapara, and Dhrishtadyumna into the God of Fire.

sa: वृत्ता यात्रा नरेन्द्राणां सेना पथ्येव वर्तते। वैराणि चैव मार्गाश्च सलिलेन समीकृताः॥
en: The royal marches are all stopped, and the soldiers, who have already marched are waiting in the way-hostility and wayfares have been equally blockaded by water.

sa: विद्रुते सहसा यज्ञे कुपिते च महेश्वरे॥ तेन ज्यातलघोषेण सर्वे लोकाः समाकुलाः।
en: When the sacrifice was destroyed and when Maheshvara was enraged, the gods were greatly frightened at the sound produced by his twanging bow and his palm-strokes.

sa: चक्ररत्नं तु यत् कृष्णे स्थितमासीन्महात्मनि। गतं तच्च पुनर्हस्ते कालेनैष्यति तस्य ह॥
en: That precious discus, which was with the great Krishna, has disappeared (from the world).. When the time again comes, it will return into and his hands.

sa: कृपस्तु शरवर्षं तद् विनिहत्य महास्त्रवित्। शिखण्डिनं रणे क्रद्धो विव्याध दशभिः शरैः॥
en: And checking that downpour of arrows Kripa, conversant with the use of mighty weapons and filled with anger, struck in that encounter Shikhandin with ten arrows.

sa: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच शृणु मूढ गुणान् कांश्चिद् ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम्। ये त्वया कीर्तिता राजंस्तेभ्योऽथ ब्राह्मणो वरः।।।।
en: The God of wind said Hear, O deluded man, what the attributes are of Brahmanas who have all high souls. The Brahmana is superior to all those which, O king, you have named.

sa: तेषां तु वाजिना भूमिः खुरैश्चित्रा विशाम्पते। अशोभत यथा नारी करजैः क्षतविक्षता॥
en: The field, O king, marked with the hoofs of horses, looked beautiful like a beautiful woman bearing the marks of (her lover's) nails on her person.

sa: कौन्तेय यदि प्रश्नांस्तान् मयोक्तान् प्रतिपत्स्यसे। ततः पास्यसि पानीयं हरिष्यसि च भारत॥
en: O son of Kunti, O Bharata, if you can answer the questions put by me, then you may drink of the water and take it away.”

sa: भारतं परमं पुण्यं भारते विविधाः कथाः। भारतं सेव्यते देवैर्भारतं परमं पदम्॥
en: The Bharata is purifying and sacred. In the Bharata are various topics. The Bharata is adored by the very gods. The Bharata is the highest end.

sa: जानानास्तु दौर्बल्यं भीमसेनमृते महत्। अस्मान् बलवतो ज्ञात्वा न यतिष्यन्ति दुर्बलाः॥ ते
en: In consequence of the death of Bhimasena, they (the Pandavas) would know themselves weak and ourselves strong; and they will not attempt to recover the kingdom.

sa: एकाकी स्पर्धते नित्यं सर्वेण जगत सह। न चान्यं पुरुषं कंचिन्मन्यते मोघदर्शनः॥
en: Alone he even boasts to fight with the entire universe, and endued with false vision he does not regard any other man as a human being.

sa: सर्प उवाच प्रमादात् सम्प्रमूढस्य भगवन् क्षन्तुमर्हसि। ततः स मामुवाचेदं प्रपतन्तं कृपान्वितः॥
en: O divine sage, graciously pardon me (because) I have been mad through pride. Thereupon, he, moved with pity addressed me while I was falling down, thus

sa: तस्माद्धस्वतरं नास्ति न ततोऽस्ति महत्तरम्। नास्ति तस्मात् सूक्ष्मतरं नास्त्यन्यत् तत्समं सुखम्॥
en: There is nothing smaller than that. There is nothing huger than that. There is nothing minuter than that. There is no happiness that can resemble it.

sa: एतत् कुरु नरेन्द्रस्य वचनं रघुनन्दन । सत्येन महता राम तारयस्व नरेश्वरम्॥
en: Oh you descendant of Raghu, do you carry out these words of the Lord of men and save him by redeeming these great vows of his.

sa: तमुत्तकोऽभिसृत्य कृतोदककार्यः शुचिः प्रयतो नमो देवेभ्यो गुरुभ्यश्च कृत्वा महता जवेन तमन्वयात्॥
en: Having completed his ablutions and purified himself and having bowed down to the divinities and spiritual masters, he ran after the thief as fast as possible.

sa: अर्जुनार्थे हनिष्यामि सकर्णान् ससुयोधनान्। श्वो निरीक्षन्तु मे वीर्ये त्रयो लोका महाहवे॥
en: I will slay them all with Karna and Duryodhana, for the sake of Arjuna. Tomorrow the three worlds will behold my prowess in the dreadful battle.

sa: दमयन्त्यै ततः प्रादात् केशिनी कुरुनन्दन। सो चिता नलसिद्धस्य मांसस्य बहुशः पुरा॥
en: O descendant of the Kuru race, thereupon Keshini gave the meat to Damayanti, who had, during the past days, very often tasted meat boiled by Nala.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच निर्याय नगराच्छूरा व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः। त्रिगर्तानस्पृशन् मत्स्याः सूर्ये परिणते सति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Issuing out from the city, those heroic repressors, the Matsya's, arranged in battle array, met the Trigartas when the sun had passed the meridian.

sa: ततो नानाप्रहरणाञ्छितधारान्सहस्रशः। पातयामास संक्रुद्धः सुरसैन्येषु रावणिः॥ शतघ्नीमुसलप्रासगदाखङ्गपरश्वधान्। महान्ति गिरिशृङ्गाणि पातयामास रावणिः॥
en: Thereupon Rāvana's son struck the celestial host with thousands of huge mountain summits, Śataghnīs, maces, Prāsas, Prāsas, clubs, daggers, Paraśus and various other sharp pointed weapons.

sa: ऋषयो न प्रकाशन्ते न देवा न.च मानुषाः। एवं तु तिमिरीभूतं निर्दहन्त्यपमानिताः॥
en: The Rishis, the gods, and human beings, looked pale. A universal darkness covered the Earth and sky. The insulted Rudras began to put fire to everything.

sa: तेजांसि यानि दृष्टानि भूमिष्ठेन त्वया विभो। वेश्मानि भुवि देवानां पश्यामूनि सहस्रशः॥
en: O lord, look at these several abodes of the gods living on the earth, you see in the form of stars and constellations in the sky.

sa: कर्ण उवाच मा शोच भरतश्रेष्ठ करिष्येऽहं प्रियं तव।॥ भीष्मः शान्तवस्तूर्णमपयातु महारणात्।
en: Karna said "Grieve not, O foremost of the Bharatas, I will compass your pleasure. Let Bhishma the son of Shantanu be speedily withdrawn from the battle.

sa: वै उच्यते॥ धिगस्तु मां सुदुर्बुद्धिं निर्लज्ज पापकृत्तमम्। अचिन्तयित्वा तां सीतामग्निदं स्वामिघातकम्॥
en: O fie on me who am vicious-minded, shameless and the perpetrator of a mighty iniquity. Not thinking of Sītā, I have slain my master with fire.

sa: साहं तस्याग्रतस्तूर्णं प्रस्थिता वनचारिणी। नहि मे तेन हीनाया वासः स्वर्गेऽपि रोचते॥
en: But myself wearing the garb of an ascetic, repaired speedily before him. Separated from him, I do not like to live even in the celestial region.

sa: सर्वोऽयं ब्राह्मणौ लोके वृत्तेन तु विधीयते। वृत्ते स्थितस्तु शूद्रोऽपि ब्राह्मणत्वं नियच्छति॥
en: All Brahmanas in this world are Brahmanas on account of conduct. A Shudra, if he is of good conduct, is considered as equal to a B-ahmana.

sa: तथा तत् पौरुषं राजंस्तावकानां परंतप। प्राप्य पाण्डुसुतान् वीरान् व्यर्थं भवति संयुगे॥
en: So also, O monarch, the mainlines of the illustrious warriors of your army opposed by that of the heroic sons of Pandu becomes baffled in battle.

sa: तरुणौ सुकुमारौ च राजपुत्रौ तरस्विनौ। युद्धानां च विशेषज्ञौ प्रणेतारौ च सर्वशः॥
en: The two young and delicate princes are of light hand and know all the details of fighting and are in every way fit to be leaders.

sa: एवमुक्तः स धर्मात्मा जगाम मिथिलां मुनिः। पद्भ्यां शक्तोऽन्तरिक्षण क्रान्तुं पृथ्वी ससागराम्॥
en: Thus instructed, the pious Shuka proceeded to Mithila on foot although he was able to go through the skies over the whole Earth with her seas.

sa: पतिं विना मृतं श्रेयो नार्याः क्षत्रियपुङ्गव। त्वद्गतिं गन्तुमिच्छामि प्रसीदस्व नयस्व माम्॥ त्वया हीना क्षणमपि नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे। प्रसादं कुरु मे राजनितस्तूर्णं नयस्व माम्॥
en: O best of Kshatriyas, death is preferable to one whom has her husband. I wish to follow the way you have gone. Be kind towards me and take me with you. I am unable in your absence to bear life for a moment. O kind to me and take me soon away.

sa: सा च तं प्रणता भूत्वा शुश्रूषणपरायणा। उवास काले धर्मिष्ठा तस्यास्तुष्टोऽभवद् गुरुः॥
en: And in all humility that virtuous one for a definite period was engaged in ministering to him. And thereat, her spiritual guide was gratified with her.

sa: क्षमयन्तं तु राजानं पाण्डवः प्रत्यभाषत। चिरं क्षान्तमिदं राजन् न मन्युर्विद्यते मम॥
en: Seeking forgiveness him, the son of Pandu said the king that I have taken the vow of pardon, so I have no anger in my mind.

sa: त्वय्यापो निहिताः सर्वास्त्वयि सर्वमिदं जगत्। न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित् त्रिषु लोकेषु पावक॥
en: Water depends on you, everything and this entire world; o you purifying element, there is not the least thing unknown to you in these three worlds.

sa: न जातु ताञ्छत्रुरन्यः सहेत येषां स स्यादग्रणीवृष्णिसिंहः। प्रवेपते मे हृदयं भयेन श्रुत्वा कृष्णावेकरथे समेतौ॥
en: No enemy whatever can withstand them whose leader is that best of the Vrishnis. My heart trembles with fear at hearing that the, two Krishna's are united together on one the same chariot.

sa: कामाभिध्या स्वशरीरं दुनोति यया प्रमुक्तो न करोति दुःखम्। यथेध्यमानस्य समिद्धतेज़सो भूयो बलं वर्धते पावकस्य॥
en: Seeking pleasure he pains his own body as fuel to a burning flame increases its force; and when a man has freed himself from this longing he does not bring misery on himself.

sa: लब्ध्वापीमां पृथिवीं सागरान्तां जरामृत्यू नैव हि त्वं प्रजह्याः। नेवं विद्वान् नैव युद्धं कुरु त्वम्॥
en: Having gained even this earth bounded by the sea, you will not get rid of descripitude or death, desirable results or undesirable, happiness or misery. O king knowing this, do not wage war.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच भवान् समर्थस्तानं सर्वान् निहन्तु नात्र संशयः। निहन्तुमहमष्येकः समर्थः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Arjuna said "There is no doubt that you can slay all of them. O foremost among men, I too, alone, am able to slay them all.

sa: यस्य कामो वर्तते नित्यमेव नान्यः शमाद् भारतानामिति स्म। स बाह्निकानामृषभो मनीषी त्वंयाभिवाद्यः संजय साधुशीलः॥
en: The one who has no other wish except that there should be peace among the Bharata race, the best among the Balhika's, a wise and honest man, should also be saluted by you.

sa: बलदेवस्य वाक्यं तु मम ज्ञाने न युज्यते। एतद्धि पुरुषेणारे कार्यं सुनयमिच्छता॥
en: In my opinion the suggestion of Baladeva is not appropriate; it can certainly be acted on by a man who is desirous of an amicable settlement.

sa: द्वा:स्थ उवाच प्रविशान्तःपुरं क्षत्तर्महाराजस्य धीमतः। नहि ते दर्शनेऽकल्पो जातु राजाऽब्रवीद्धि माम्॥
en: The gate keeper said O Kshattri, enter the inner apartments of the wise king; the king told me that he was never unwilling to see you.

sa: स भीष्मामन्त्र्य कुरुप्रवीरं वैचित्रवीर्यं च महानुभावम्। द्रोणं सपुत्रं विदुरं कृपं च गान्धारराजं च ससूतपुत्रम्।।
en: Let him invite Bhishma, the heroic son of Kuru and the noble minded of Vichitravirya, Drona, with his son, Vidura and Kripa and the king of Gandhara with the son of Suta. son

sa: अमित्रं कुरुते मित्रं मित्रं द्वेष्टि हिनस्ति च। कर्म चारभते दुष्टं तमाहुर्मूढचेतसम्॥
en: He is said be foolish-minded who makes friends of those that are foes and who hates and slays that are well-wishers and who commits wicked acts.

sa: तानागतानभिप्रेक्ष्य मत्स्यो धर्मभृतां वरः। पूजयामास विधिवत् सभृत्यबलवाहनान्॥ प्रीतोऽभवद् दुहितरं दत्त्वा तामभिमन्यवे।
en: The king, the foremost of the virtuous, duly worshipped them all along with their servants and troops. And having given away his daughter, he was pleased.

sa: दम्भं मोहं मत्सरं पापकृत्यं राजद्विष्टं पैशुनं पूगवैरम्। मत्तोन्मत्तैर्दुर्जनैश्चापि धादं यः प्रज्ञावान् वर्जयेत् स प्रधानः॥
en: The wise man who keeps away pride, folly, impertinence, sinful deeds, disloyalty towards his sovereign, roguery enmity with many, speech with the drunk, the insane and the wicked, is a chief among men,

sa: सर्वे शान्तिपरा योधाः स्वचित्तानि न लेभिरे। संग्रामे विमुखाः सर्वे योधास्ते हतचेतसः॥
en: They all were stunned (inert and dumb) with no conscious at all. All soldiers discouraged to carry on fight and showed their back to the battle-field.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन पाण्डवं रथिनां वरम्। द्रोणः प्रत्युद्ययौ पार्थं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Drona rushed with great force towards Partha, the son of Pandu, the foremost of carwarriors, who was advancing like a mad elephant rushing at another such.

sa: एतेन युध्यमानस्य यत्त: संयच्छ मे हयान्॥ ततोऽभ्यवहदव्यग्रो वैराटिः सव्यसाचिनाम्। यत्रातिष्ठत् कृपो राजन् योत्स्यमानो धनंजयम्॥
en: While fighting with him you should carefully restrain your horses. Thus addressed by him the son of Virata carefully drove Savyasachi's car, O king, to where Kripa stood in anticipation of the battle.

sa: प्रापयस्वैष राजा हि प्रमाथी युद्धदुर्मदः॥ एष द्रोणस्य शिष्याणां शीघ्रास्त्रे प्रथमो मतः।
en: The king is irrepressible in battle and capable of grinding (enemies); in lightness of hand he is regarded as the foremost amongst the disciples of Drona.

sa: दमो ह्यष्टादशगुणः प्रतिकूलं कृताकृते। अनृतं चाभ्यसूया च कामार्थौ च तथा स्पृहा।॥ क्रोधः शोकस्तथा तृष्णा लोभः पैशुन्यमेव च। मत्सरच विहिंसा च परितापस्तथाऽरतिः॥ अपस्मारश्चातिवादस्तथा सम्भावनाऽऽत्मनि। एतैर्विमुक्तो दोषैर्यः स दान्तः सद्भिरुच्यते॥
en: Self-control has for its elements eighteen virtues, the non-observance through laziness of acts prescribed in the Vedas, untruthfulness, malice, desire, wealth, love of pleasure, anger, grief, thirst, avarice, deceitfulness, delight at the pain of others, envy, repentance, aversion from virtues and noble acts, forgetfulness, speaking ill of others and well or self-he who is freed from these vices is said to possess selfcontrol by good people.

sa: कामं गच्छन्तु कुरवो धनमादाय केवलम्। रथेषु वापि तिष्ठन्तो युद्धं पश्यन्तु मामकम्॥
en: Let the Kauravas at their own will go away with the precious kine; if they wish let them remain on the chariot and behold the encounter.

sa: मनसा चिन्तयामास प्रसादं पावकस्य च। स च तच्चिन्तितं ज्ञात्वा ध्वजे भूतान्यदेशयत्॥
en: As soon as he thought of the favour of Agni in his mind the deity, knowing his desire, ordered the creatures (to sit) on the flag.

sa: त्वामेवायं रथो वोढुं संग्रामेऽर्हति धन्विनम्। त्वं चेमं रथमास्थाय योद्धुम) मतो मम॥
en: This car is capable of carrying a bowman like you in battle and you are also worthy of fighting on this car. This is my conviction.

sa: पुरा शक्रेण मे दत्तं युध्यतो दानवर्षभैः। किरीटं मूर्ध्नि सूर्याभं तेनाहुर्मी किरीटिनम्॥
en: A diadem, brilliant like the sun, was formerly placed on my head by Indra during my fight with the Danavas and hence they call me Kiritin.

sa: अस्यां हि पाण्डुपुत्राणां धनूंषि निहितान्युत। युधिष्ठिरस्य भीमस्य बीभत्सोर्यमयोस्तथा॥ ध्वजाः शराश्च शूराणां दिव्यानि कवचानि च।
en: Therefore, O prince, climb this tree full of fruits for in it are tied the bows, shafts, banners and beautiful armours of the heroic sons of Pandu, Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna and the twins.

sa: ततस्तांश्चोदयामास सदश्वान् पाण्डुनन्दनः। ते हया नरसिंहेन नोदिता वातरंहसः। आलिखन्त इवाकाशमूहः काञ्चनमालिनः॥
en: Thereupon the son of Pandu urged on the beautiful horses. Being urged on by that foremost of men, those horses, endued with the velocity of wind.

sa: यः स काशिपती राजा वाराणस्यां महारथः। स तेषामभवद् योद्धा तेन वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: He who is the Lord of Kashi, the carwarrior who is the king of Varanasi, has become their warrior, with him they will fight with you.

sa: न हि तस्य महाबाहोः शक्रप्रतिमतेजसः। सैन्येऽस्मिन् प्रतिपश्यामि य एनं विषहेद् युधि॥
en: In this entire army do I not see one who can withstand in battle this one of long arms and having strength like that of Shakra.

sa: प्रतिनन्दामि ते वाक्यं मनोज्ञं मत्स्य भाषसे॥ आनृशंस्यपरो नित्यं सुसुखी सततं भव।
en: O king of Matsya, we highly relish the delightful words you have given vent to. Being humane towards all do you live happily ever and anon.

sa: गले गृहीत्वा राजानमानीय विवशं वशम्। तत एनं विचेष्टन्तं बद्धवा पार्थो वृकोदरः॥
en: Then holding the king (Susharma) by the neck who was unconscious, bringing him and binding him who could make no exertion, Vrikodara, the son of Pritha,

sa: अभज्यत बलं सर्वं त्रैगर्तं तद् भयातुरम्॥ निवर्त्य गास्ततः सर्वा: पाण्डुपुत्रा महारथाः।
en: The entire army, of Trigarta afflicted with fear, were dispersed. Thereupon preventing the kine from being taken away, all the mighty carwarriors, the sons of Pandu,

sa: तदा ह्यभीक्ष्णं सुबहून् प्रकारान् श्रोतास्मि तानावसथे कुरूणाम्। तेषां समन्ताच्च तथा रणाग्रे क्षयः किलायं भरतानुपैति॥
en: When I shall see and hear innumerable kinds of evil omens in the camp of the Kurus and around them and before the battle, then will destruction come to the race of Bharata.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य च क्रोधादर्जुनस्य च विक्रमात्। यमाभ्यां भीमसेनाच्च भयं मे तात जायते॥
en: From the wrath of Yudhishthira and from the prowess of Arjuna and from the twins and also from Bhimasena, do I derive great fear, O dear.

sa: यस्य भीमार्जुनौ योधौ स राजा राजसत्तम। तथा भीमहतप्रायां मज्जन्तीं तव वाहिनीम्॥
en: He who has the two warriors, Bhima and Arjuna, on his side, O best of kings is the king seeing your army nearly killed by Bhima.

sa: दुर्योधनसुताः सर्वे तथा दुःशासनस्य च। सौभद्रेण कृतो भागो राजा चैव बृहद्बलः॥
en: In the way all the sons of Duryodhana and Dushasana have been accepted by the son of Subhadra as his share, as also the king Brihadbala.

sa: देवैर्हि सम्भृतो दिव्यो रथो गाण्डीवधन्वनः। न स जेयो मनुष्येण मा स्म कृदूध्वं मनो युधि॥
en: By the gobs themselves in the heavenly car of the wielder of the Gandiva bow protected; he cannot be defeated by men; do not think in mind even of a fight with him.

sa: सम्पूर्णं पूरयन् भूयो धनं पार्थस्य माधवः। शैनेयः समरे स्थाता बीजवत् प्रवपशरान्॥
en: Increasing in strength, what was already full, viz., Yudhishthira's army the son of Shini will stand on the field shooting arrows as one sows the seeds.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यदबूतां महात्मानौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ। तन्मे ब्रूहि महाप्राज्ञ शुश्रूषे वचनं तव॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What the two great-souled ones, the son of Vasudeva and Dhananjaya, said? Tell me that, O exceedingly wise one. I shall hear your words.

sa: क्रव्याट्य इव भूतानामदान्तेभ्यः सदा भयम्। येषां च प्रतिषेधार्थं क्षत्रं सृष्टं स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: Those who are devoid of self-control are ever feared by creatures as Rakshasas, for whose check Kshatriyas were created by Him who is born of Himself.

sa: नरेन्द्र बहुशोऽन्विष्टा नैव विद्यश्च पाण्डवान्। अत्यन्तं वा विनष्टास्ते भद्रं तुभ्यं नरर्षभ॥
en: We have made many inquires, O king, but we have not found out the Pandavas; may good betide you. O king; it seems they have perished.

sa: सैरभ्युवाच त्रयोदशाहमात्रं मे राजा क्षाम्यतु भामिनि। कृतकृत्या भविष्यन्ति गन्धर्वास्ते न संशयः॥
en: Sairandhri said O fair queen, let the king permit me to live here for thirteen days more. Undoubtedly the Gandharvas shall be highly obliged for this.

sa: गच्छ सैरन्ध्र भद्रं ते यथाकामं वरानने। बिभेति राजा सुश्रोणि गन्धर्वेभ्यः पराभवात्॥
en: Go Sairandhri, wherever you like; may good betide you, O fair one, O you having beautiful eye-brows, the king is afraid of defeat from the Gandharvas.

sa: उवाच च महातेजा द्रौपदी योषितां वराम्। पश्यैनमेहि पाञ्चालि कामुकोऽयं यथा कृतः॥
en: Gifted with great energy (as he was) he said to Draupadi, that best of women “Behold, O Panchali, what I have done of this hurtful wretch."

sa: ज्ञातयश्चैव भूयिष्ठाः सहाया गुरवश्च नः। तेषां वधोऽतिपापीयान् किं नो युद्धेऽस्ति शोभनम्।।४५
en: We have many cousins; and our elders are supporters (on both sides). Their destruction is extremely vicious. What then is the good in engaging in battle?

sa: युद्धे कृष्ण कलिनित्यं प्राणां सीदन्ति संयुगे। बलं तु नीतिमाधाय युध्ये जयपराजयौ।॥
en: In battle, O Krishna, Kali is ever present; in a battle lives are lost; but, in spite of fixed policy applied to fighting, success and defeat.

sa: अस्याः प्रदोषे शर्वर्याः कुरुष्वानेन संगतम्। दुःखं शोकं च निर्धूय याज्ञसेनि शुचिस्मिते॥
en: O Yagaseni of beautiful smile, having given up your sorrow and grief do so as will bring him on good terms with you on tomorrow's evening.

sa: प्रजायां रक्ष्यमाणायामात्मा भवति रक्षितः। आत्मा हि जायते तस्यां तेन जायां विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: Offspring being protected, soul is saved. In a wife one's own self is begotten and it is therefore the wife is called Jaya by the wise.

sa: यदि प्रशममिच्छेयुः कुरवः पाण्डवैः सह। तथापि युद्धं दाशाह योजयेथाः सहैव तैः॥
en: If even the sons of Kuru desire peace with the sons of Pandu, still do you provoke war with them, O you of the Dasharha race.

sa: यथा च कर्कटी गर्भमाधत्ते मृत्युमात्मनः :1 तथाविधमहं मन्ये वासं तव शुचिस्मिते॥
en: As a crab conceives for her own death so. O you of pleasant smiles, my desire for your stay here will surely be ruinous to me.

sa: तृतीयं गृह्यतां पुत्र वरमप्रतिमं महत्। त्वं हि मत्प्रभवो राजन् विदुरश्च ममांशजः॥
en: O son, accept a third great and unparalleled boon. O king, you have been begotten by me and Vidura is born of a portion of mine.

sa: प्रवृणीष्वापरं सौम्य वरमिष्टं ददानि ते। न तृष्यामि नरश्रेष्ठ प्रयच्छन् वै वरांस्तथा।॥
en: O amiable one, crave another boon that you desire. I will give it. O best of men, I am not satisfied with conferring boons on you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सार्थः प्रवसतो मित्रं भार्या मित्रं गृहे सतः। आतुरस्य भिषमित्रं दानं मित्रं मरिष्यतः॥
en: Yudhishthira replied The friend of an exile is his companion; that of a householder is his wife; that of a sick person is his physician and that of a dying one is charity.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच देवतातिथिभृत्यानां पितृणामात्मनश्च यः। न निर्वपति पञ्चानामुच्छ्वसन् न स जीवति॥
en: Yudhishthira said : That person, who does not satisfy the gods, the guests, the servants, the Pitris and his own self, though breathing, is not alive.

sa: यक्ष उवाच केनस्विच्छ्रोत्रियो भवति केनस्विद् विन्दते महत्। केनस्विद् द्वितीयवान् भवति राजन् केन च बुद्धिमान्।४७
en: The Yaksha said : What makes one Shrotriya (learned) By what does one attain to what is very exalted? what makes one have a second And, by what, O king, one becomes wise?

sa: एतानेव पुरोधाय सत्कृत्य च यथा पुरा। अखिला भोक्ष्यसे सर्वां पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥
en: Keeping their interests well before you and treating them well, as in days gone by will you enjoy this entire earth, O lord of the earth.

sa: शिवेनेमे भूमिपाला: समागम्य परस्परम्। सह भुक्त्वा च पीत्वा च प्रतियान्तु यथागृहम्॥
en: These protectors of the earth meeting one another in a spirit of peace and having dined and drank together, let them return to their respective homes.

sa: रणे प्रमत्तौ वीरौ च सदा शत्रुनिबर्हणौ॥ कथं रिपुवशं यातौ कुन्तीपुत्रौ महाबलौ। यौ सर्वास्त्राप्रतिहतौ भीमसेनधनंजयौ॥
en: Why have these two highly powerful and heroic sons of Kunti, Bhimasena and Dhananjaya, furious in battle, who always destroyed their enemies and whom no weapons could resist, been subjugated by the enemy?

sa: यदि दास्यामि ते देव कुण्डले कवचं तथा। वध्यतामुपयास्यामि त्वं च शक्रावहास्यताम्॥
en: If, O god, I give you my ear-rings and armour, I shall be liable to be killed and you, too will be an object of ridicule.

sa: एतद् गुह्यं महाराज सूर्यस्यासीन्न संशयः। यः सूर्यसम्भवः कर्णः कुन्त्यां सूतकुले तथा॥
en: And O great king, that Karna begotten by him on Kunti was growing up in the race of the Sutas, was, no doubt known to Surya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गते तस्मिन् द्विजश्रेष्ठे कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे। चिन्तयामास सा कन्या मन्त्रग्रामबलाबलम्॥
en: That best of the twice-born ones having gone away on some other business, the maiden began to think of the efficacy or otherwise of the Mantras.

sa: मम कन्या महाप्राज्ञ पृथा नाम यशस्विनी। शीलवृत्तान्विता साध्वी नियता चैव भाविनी॥
en: "O highly wise one, I have a renowned daughter, Pritha by name. That damsel is endowed with good manners, is observant of vows, chaste and self-controlled.

sa: चक्षुषी च स्वराज्यं च द्वौ वरौ श्वशुरस्य मे। लब्धं पितुः पुत्रशतं पुत्राणां चात्मनः शतम्॥
en: I have obtained two boons for my father-inlaw viz. recovery of his sight and kingdom. I have (further), obtained for my father a hundred sons and an equal number of sons for myself.

sa: न स्मराम्युक्तपूर्वं वै स्वैरेष्वप्यनृतां गिरम्॥ तेन सत्येन तावद्य ध्रियेतां श्वशुरौ ममा
en: I do not remember to have offered a falsehood even in jest. By virtue of that truth may my father-in-law and mother-in-law remain alive this day.

sa: श्वः प्रभाते वने दृश्ये यास्यावोऽनुमते तव। वसावेह क्षपामेकां रुचितं यदि तेऽनघ॥
en: We shall, with your leave, go tomorrow when the forest will be visible. O sinless one, we shall remain here for the night if you wish.

sa: अयं ते सत्यवान भर्ता क्षीणायुः पार्थिवात्मजः। नेष्यामि तमहं बद्ध्वा विद्ध्यतन्मे चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: The years of this prince, your husband, being numbered, I will bind (him with this noose) and take him hence. Know this to be my। intention.

sa: पूर्यदुश्च द्वौ वंशे वर्धमानौ नरोत्तमौ। ताभ्यां प्रतिष्ठितो लोके परलोके च नाहुषः॥
en: The two best among men Puru and Yadu perpetuating the family were established (as king) in this world and the son of Nahusha in the next.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तान् सर्वान् विश्रान्तः सहसैनिकः। उवाच मध्य वीराणां कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम्॥
en: Saluted those kings in return; and after resting himself with his army he said, in the midst of those heroes, to Dhananjaya the son of Kunti.

sa: मेध्यारण्यं स गत्वा च धुमत्सेनाश्रमं नृपः। पद्भ्यामेव द्विजैः सार्धं राजर्षि तमुपागमत्॥
en: Having reached the hermitage of Dyumatsena (situate) in the sacred forest, the king (Ashvapati) accompanied by the Brahmanas advanced on foot to meet that royal sage.

sa: राजन् दुर्योधनं बद्ध्वा ततः संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। त्वत्कृते न विनश्येयुः क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ।॥
en: O king, having bound Duryodhana make peace with the sons of Pandu. By so doing will the Kshatriyas not be exterminated, O foremost among the Kshatriyas.

sa: निर्याणे स मतिं कृत्वा निधायासिं क्षपाचरः। आज्ञापयामास तदा रथो मे कल्प्यतामिति॥
en: Then resolving to set out (for the field of battle himself) that night-ranger put his sword into sheath and ordered his attendants) to prepare his car.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततः प्रहस्तः सहसा समभ्येत्य विभीषणम्। गतया ताडयामास विनद्य रणकर्कशः॥
en: Markandeya said : Then Prahasta, harsh in battle, rushing against Vibhishana all on a sudden and sending forth a terrible yell, smote him with his mace.

sa: कृतघ्नं तमहं मन्ये वानरापसदं भुवि। यो मामेवंगतो मूढो न जानीतेऽद्य लक्ष्मण॥
en: I deem that worst of monkeys to be highly ungrateful on earth, because, O Lakshmana, that wretch has now forgotten me reduced to such a plight!

sa: विवशां धर्षयित्वा च कां त्वं प्रीतिमवाप्स्यसि। प्रजापतिसमो विप्रो ब्रह्मयोनिः पिता तव॥
en: What pleasure will you derive from violating an unwilling woman? Your father is equal to the lord of (all) creatures, a Brahmana and begotten of Brahma.

sa: न विशेषस्तयोर्युद्धे यदा कश्चन् दृश्यते। सुग्रीवस्य तदा मालां हनुमान् कण्ठ आसजत्॥
en: (On account of their similarity appearance) no difference (in aspect) could be discovered between those fighters. Hanuman then placed a garland round the neck of Sugriva.

sa: तेन त्वं सह संगम्य दुःखमूलं निवेदय। समानशीलो भवतः साहाय्यं स करिष्यति॥
en: Do you go to him and inform him of the cause of your sorrow. Being in the same predicament as you are, he will help you.

sa: तस्य देहाद् विनिःसृत्य पुरुषो दिव्यदर्शनः। ददृशे दिवमास्थाय दिवि सूर्य इव ज्वलन्॥
en: Then a being of celestials appearance issued out of his body and stationing himself in the air appeared as resplendent as the sun in the heavens.

sa: इदं पुंसवनं चैव वीराजननमेव च। अभीक्ष्णं गर्भिणी श्रुत्वा ध्रुवं वीरं प्रजायते॥
en: This story makes a woman bring forth a son and a heroic, son; a pregnant woman hearing it repeated many times certainly bring forth a hero,

sa: स बाधते प्रजाः सर्वा विप्रकारैर्महाबलः। ततो नस्त्रातु भगवन् नान्यस्त्राता हि विद्यते॥
en: The mighty powerful one is oppressing the creatures in every possible way; therefore save us, O lord; there is none else except you to save us.

sa: मित्राणि ते प्रहृष्यन्तु व्यथन्तु रिपवस्तथा। सौमात्रं चैव तेऽद्यास्तु भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवैः॥
en: Let your friends rejoice in the same way let your enemies feel pained; let there be today brotherly feelings with your brothers, the sons of Pandu.

sa: आपो नारास्तत्तनव इत्यपां नाम शुश्रुम। अयनं तेन चैवास्ते तेन नारायणः स्मृतः॥
en: The water was the body of the (Rishi) Nara and we hear it called Nara; and because it formed his resting place he is called Narayana.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सूर्यानिश्चरितां कर्णः शुश्राव भारतीम्। दुरत्ययां प्रणयिनी पितृवद् भास्करेरिताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Karna hear an affectionate voice issue from the solar disc from afar, spoken with the affection of a father by Surya himself.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं च भीमं च यमौ चैवार्जुनादृते। अर्जुनेन समं युद्धमपि यौधिष्ठिरे बले॥
en: There are Yudhishthira, Bhima, and the twins, in fact every one save Arjuna; Arjuna alone in the army of Yudhishthira is worthy to fight with me.

sa: कथं तस्य कुले जातः कुलभेदं व्यवस्यसि। सम्भूय भ्रातृभिः सार्धं भुड्क्ष्वभोगान् जनाधिप॥
en: How do you, born in his family, dare bringing about a dissension between the united with your brothers, enjoy objects of enjoyment, O lord of men.

sa: पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च राज्ञाममिततेजसाम्। विररामैवमुक्त्वा तु विदुरो दीनमानसः। प्रध्यायमानः स तदा निःश्वसंश्च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Of the sons of Panda, the Kurus, and of kings of immeasurable energy.” Saying this Vidura stopped with his heart sad. And thinking of the situation he began to sign again and again.

sa: न किंचिदीड्यं प्रवदन्ति पापं वनेचरं वा गृहमेधिनं वा। तपस्विनं सम्परिपूर्णविद्यं भषन्ति हैवं श्वनराः सुवीरा॥
en: O Sauvira, (the wise) never speak ill of learned persons carrying on devout penances, no matter whether they live in forest or houses; it is only the mean like dogs who speak so.

sa: निर्याताश्च विनाशाय कुरुक्षेत्रं नराधिपाः। एतत् ते कथितं राजन् यद् वृत्तं कुरुसंसदि॥
en: The lords of men have set out for Kurukshetra-only to meet with destruction; I have now toid you what happened in the assembly of the Kurus.

sa: कर्ण उवाच दिष्ट्या कामः सुसंवृत्तो दिष्ट्या कौरव वर्धसे। दिष्ट्या ते शत्रवो मग्ना दुस्तरे व्यसनार्णवे॥ दुर्वासः क्रोधजे वह्नौ पतिताः पाण्डुनन्दनाः। स्वैरेव ते महापापैर्गता वै दुस्तरं तमः॥
en: Karna said: By singular good luck, you have fared well and attained to the fulfilment of your desire. By good luck your enemies have been plunged into the sea of misery which is difficult to cross. The Pandavas are now exposed to the fire of Durvasa's anger. Through their own fault they have fallen into an abyss of darkness.

sa: ऋभवो नाम तत्रान्ये देवानामपि देवताः। तेषां लोकात् परतरे यान् यजन्तीह देवताः॥
en: There live certain beings called Ribhus, they are the gods of the gods. Their region is highly blessed and they are adored even by the celestials.

sa: पुरस्ताद् ब्राह्मणास्तत्र लोकास्तेजोमयाः शुभाः। यत्र यान्त्यषयो ब्रह्मन् पूताः स्वैः कर्मभिः शुभैः॥
en: Of these, the charming and effulgent region of Brahma is the highest. O Brahmana, there go the Rishis that have been purified by their meritorious acts.

sa: इह यत् क्रियते कर्म तत् परत्रोपयुज्यते। तस्माच्छरीरं युञ्जीत तपसा नियमेन च॥
en: The fruits of acts done in this world are obtained in the next world. Therefore one restrains his body by asceticism and the observance of vows.

sa: तस्मिन् यत्नः कृतोऽस्माभिः स नो हीनः प्रयत्नतः। अकृते तु प्रयत्नेऽस्मानुपावृत्तः कलिर्महान्॥
en: The object, for which we took so much care, leaves as for our wishing it; and without our wishing for it has the mighty Kali come.

sa: ततो युद्धेष्वभज्यन्त त्रयो वर्णाः पुनः पुनः। क्षत्रियाच जयन्त्येव बहुलं चैकतो बलम्॥
en: The three orders broke up again and again in the battle that followed and the Kshatriyas were victorious over that large army though they were alone.

sa: यद् दुरापं भवेत् किंचित् तत्सर्वं तपसो भवेत्। ऐश्वर्यमृषयः प्राप्तास्तपसैव न संशयः॥
en: Whatever things there are which seem to be unattainable are sure to be acquired by penance. forsooth, the Rishis acquired their sixfold divine attributes through penance.

sa: इत्येष वृत्रमाश्रित्य ज्वरस्य महतो मया। विस्तरः कथितः पुत्र किमन्यत् प्रब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Thus, O son, while describing the story of Vritra have I recited to you fully the narrative of Fever! What else shall I describe to you?

sa: प्रस्थिता देवता दृष्ट्वा शैलराजसुता तदा। उवाच वचनं साध्वी देवं पशुपति पतिम्॥ भगवन् क्वनु यान्त्येते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः। ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन तत्त्वज्ञ संशयो मे महानयम्॥
en: Seeing the deities depart, the excellent daughter of the king of mountains, addressed her divine husband, viz., the Lord of all creatures, and said, O illustrious one, who are those gods headed by Shakra going? O you who know the truth, tell me truly, for a great doubt has possessed my mind.

sa: भृगुरुवाच सत्यं ब्रह्म तपः सत्यं सत्यं विसृजते प्रजाः। सत्येन धार्यते लोकः स्वर्गं सत्येन गच्छति॥
en: Bhrigu said Truth is Brahma; truth is Penance it is Truth which Creates all creatures. Truth sustains the entire universe and it is with the help of Truth that one goes to Heaven.

sa: अनृतं तमसो रूपं तमसा नीयते ह्यधः। तमोग्रस्ता न पश्यन्ति प्रकाशं तमसाऽऽवृताः॥
en: Untruth is only another shape of Darkness. It is Darkness that leads downwards. Those who are possessed by Darkness, cannot see the bright regions of Heaven.

sa: स्वजनं हि यदा मृत्युर्हन्त्येव तव पश्यतः। कृतेऽपि यत्ने महति तत्र बोद्धव्यमात्मना॥
en: When your relatives are carried away by Death in your very presence and despite you utmost efforts to save them, that circumstance alone should awaken you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच इमे वै मानवाः सर्वे धर्म प्रति विशङ्किताः। कोऽयं धर्मः कुतो धर्मस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥ धर्मस्त्वयमिहार्थः किमुत्रार्थोऽपि वा भवेत्। उभयार्थो हि वा धर्मस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhisthira said All men who live on this Earth, are filled with doubts regarding the nature .or righteousness. Who is this that is called Righteousness? Whence also does Righteousness come? come? Tell me this, O Grandfather! Is Righteousness for this world or for the next world? Or, is it for both here and hereafter? Tell me this, O grandfather?"

sa: व्यास उवाच एषा पूर्वतरा वृत्तिाह्मणस्य विधीयते। ज्ञानवानेव कर्माणि कुर्वन् सर्वत्र सिध्यति॥
en: Vyasa said These then are the obligatory acts laid down for Brahmanas. One gifted with knowledge, always attains to success by going through (the prescribed acts).

sa: विद्म चैवं न वा विद्म शक्यं वा वेदितुं न वा। अणीयान् क्षुरधाराया गरीयानपि पर्वतात्॥
en: Whether we know it or not, whether we are able to determine it or not, the course of duty is sharper than the edge of a razor and grosser than even a mountain.

sa: त्रैलोक्यस्याधिपत्यं वा तुष्टो रुद्रः प्रयच्छति। मनसापि शिवं तात ये प्रपद्यन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Those men, O sire, who adore Bhava even mentally, succeed in freeing themselves from all sins and live in the celestial region with all the gods.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच पर्वकाले तु सम्प्राप्ते यो वै च्छेदनभेदनम्। करिष्यति नरो मोहात् तमेषानुगमिष्यति॥
en: This sin that you shall take, shall assail the man who through stupefaction of judgement will cut or tear any of you on a full-moon day.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच यस्त्वांज्वलन्तमासाद्य स्वयं वै मानवः क्वचित्। बीजौषधिरसैर्वते न यक्ष्यति तमोवृतः॥ तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं तत्रैव च निवत्स्यति। ब्रह्मवध्या हव्यवाह व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: That portion of Brahmanicide which you will take upon yourself shall immediately enter into, and leaving you shall live in, that man who, overwhelmed by the quality of darkness, will abstain from offering your blazing form, seeds, herbs, and juices. O carrier of oblations, let the fever of your heart be dispelled.

sa: गृध्र उवाच अहो वत नृशंसेन जम्बुकेनाल्पमेधसा। क्षुद्रेणोक्ता हीनसत्त्वा मानुषाः किं निवर्तथ॥
en: The Vulture said Alas, you men shorn of strength of mind, why do you turn back at the call of a cruel, nmean and little-witted jackal.

sa: आकिंचन्ये न मोक्षोऽस्ति किंचन्ये नास्ति बन्धनम्। किंचन्ये चेतरे चैव जन्तुर्ज्ञानेन मुच्यते॥
en: Liberation does not exist in poverty; nor is bondage to be seen in riches. One acquires Liberation through Knowledge only, whether one is poor or rich.

sa: तथा तानपि संवृद्धान् दृष्ट्वा चाप्नुवतां मुदम्। शकुनौ निर्भयौ तत्र उपतुश्चात्मजैः सह॥
en: Seeing their young ones endued with wings, the parent birds became very happy and continued to live in the Rishi's head with them in perfect confidence.

sa: स हि संकर्षणः प्रोक्तः प्रद्युम्नं सोऽप्यजीजनत्। प्रद्युम्नादनिरुद्धोऽहं सर्गो मम पुनः पुनः॥
en: That Shesha is called by the name of Sankarshana. Sankarshana creates Praddyumna. From Praddyumna I take birth myself as Aniruddha. I Aniruddha. I create (myself) repeatedly.

sa: याः क्रियाः सम्प्रयुक्ताश्च एकान्तगतबुद्धिभिः। ताः सर्वाः शिरसा देवः प्रतिगृह्णाति वै स्वयम्॥
en: Whatever rites and religious acts are performed by persons whose souls are entirely given to him, are all received by that great God on his head.

sa: तं चाह भगवांस्तुष्टो ग्रन्थकारो भविष्यसि। वत्साक्षया च ते कीर्तिपैलोक्ये वै भविष्यति॥
en: Pleased with him, the illustrious god said to him You will become a great author. O son, your fame shall be eternal in the three worlds.

sa: नारद उवाच यदर्थमात्रप्रभवेण जन्म कृतं त्वया धर्मगृहे चतुर्धा! तत्साध्यतां लोकहितार्थमद्य गच्छामि द्रष्टुं प्रकृतिं तवाद्याम्॥
en: Narada said Let that object be fulfilled for which you, O Self-born Being, have taken birth in four forms in the house of Dharma! I shall now go for seeing your original nature.

sa: तव चैव गुणश्लाघी पुत्र उत्पत्स्यते महान्। अस्मद्वंशकरः श्रीमान् सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Of you too shall be born a powerful and glorious son who, gifted with virtue, shall perpetuate my race. Truly do I say this to you.

sa: अत्र गाथाः पुरा गीताः शृणु राज्ञा ययातिना। धार्यन्ते या द्विजैस्तात मोक्षशास्त्रविशारदैः॥
en: Regarding it, there is a saying sung of old by king Yayati, and remembered, O sire, by all persons conversant with the Scriptures dealing with Liberation.

sa: दुर्बलं बलवन्तं च शूरं भीरूं जडं कविम्। अप्राप्तं सर्वकामार्थान् मृत्युरादाय गच्छति॥
en: Death carries away the weak, the strong, the brave, the timid, the idiotic, and the learned, before any of these acquires the fruits of his acts.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः स ऋषिरेकाग्रस्तां स्त्रियं प्रत्यभाषत। आस्यतां रुचितश्छन्दः किं च कार्यं ब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Bhishma said The Rishi, bent upon finding out the faults of women, addressed that lady saying Cease to speak to me thus! Yearning originates from liking. Tell ine what I am to do.

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शो रसो रूपं गन्थः पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि च। पृथगात्मान आत्मानं संश्लिष्टा जतुकाष्ठवत्॥
en: Sound, touch, taste, form, and scent, these, and the senses, though different in their essences, exist yet in a state of unison like lac and wood.

sa: गाधोदके मत्स्य इव सुखं विन्देत कस्तदा॥ तदैव वन्ध्यं दिवसमिति विद्याद् विचक्षणः।
en: What man is there who would, like a fish in a shallow water, feel happy? Death approaches a man before all his desires have been fulfilled.

sa: सर्वेषां यः सुहृन्नित्यं सर्वेषां च हिते रतः। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा स धर्म वेद जाजले।॥
en: He, O Jajali, only knows morality or righteousness is, who is always the friend of all creatures and who is always engaged in the behoof of all creatures, in thought, word, and deed.

sa: न ह्यन्यत् तीरमासाद्य पुन स्तर्तुं व्यवस्यति। दुर्लभो दृश्यते ह्यस्य विनिपातो महार्णवे॥
en: One who has gone to the other end of the ocean, wishes not to cross the sea for returning to the bank whence he had sailed.

sa: ऋषिर्दृष्ट्वा नृपं तत्र जगहें सुभृशं तदा। कर्ता पापस्य महतो भ्रूणहा किमिहागतः॥
en: Seeing the king before him, the sage reproved him, saying,-You have committed a great sin. You have been guilty of foeticide. Why have you come here.

sa: अन्तरिक्षाच्च कौरव्य दण्डः कृष्णाजिनं च ह॥ पपात भूमिं राजेन्द्र शुकस्यार्थे महात्मनः।
en: There fell from the sky, O son of Kuru, an ascetic's stick and a dark deer skin for the use, O king, of the great Shuka.

sa: समरेषु च विक्रान्तं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्। आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह॥ मया विनिर्जिताः पूर्वं मरुतश्च शचीपते। त्वमेव शक्र जानासि देवासुरसमागमे॥ नियतं कालपाशेन बद्धं शक्र विकस्थसे। समेता विबुधा भग्नास्तरसा समरे मया। पर्वताश्चासकृत् क्षिप्ताः सवनाः सवनौकसः॥
en: The energy and might used to display in all my battles, prove it clearly. The Adityas, the Rudras, the Saddhyas, the Vasus, and the Maruts, O lord of Shachi, were all defeated by me. You know it well yourself, O Shakra, that in the great battle between the gods and the Asuras, the assembled gods were speedily। routed by me by the fury of my attack. Mountains with their forests and the denizens, were repeatedly hurled by us.

sa: स्व्युरुवाच शिरसा प्रणमे विप्र प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि। भूमौ निपतमानायाः शरणं भव मेऽनघ॥
en: The lady said I bow to you. You should show me your favour. O sinless one, I prostrate myself before you, do you become my refuge.

sa: न चेदमचलं स्थानमनन्तं वापि कस्यचित्। त्वं तु बालिशया बुद्ध्या ममेदमिति मन्यसे॥
en: Having secured your present position of yours. With none did it last for ever. On account of a foolish understanding, you consider it immutable and eternal.

sa: शक्र उवाच नास्ति देवमनुष्येषु सर्वभूतेषु वा पुमान्। यस्त्वामेको विषहितुं शक्नुयात् कमलालये॥
en: Shakra said O you who live in lotuses, there is not a single person among gods, men, and all creatures, that can bear you for ever!

sa: इष्टं दत्तमधीतं च व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये। ह्वीः कीर्तिः श्रीर्युतिस्तुष्टिः सिद्धिश्चैव तदर्पणी।।४१२
en: The merit of sacrifices, gifts, the study of the Vedas, vows, practices of restraint, Modesty, Fame, Prosperity, Glory, Contentment, and Success, are all for acquiring you.

sa: इन्द्रियाणीह सर्वाणि स्वे स्वे स्थाने यथाविधि। अनीशत्वात् प्रलीयन्ते सर्पा हतविषा इव॥
en: On account of their inability to act without their director, the senses, during slumber, all become extinguished in their respective places like snakes shorn of poison.

sa: यानीन्द्रियाणीह मनश्च कृत्स्रं ये वायवः सप्त तथैव चाग्नयः। ये देवसंस्थास्तवदेवताश्च तस्मात् परं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति॥
en: The Rishis say that you are superior to the senses, the mind, the vital air, the seven fires, everything else which rests upon the allpervading Soul and all the celestials who are worshipped.

sa: पञ्चैव तानि कालश्च भावाभावौ च केवलौ। अष्टौ भूतानि भूतानां शाश्वतानि भवात्ययौ॥
en: These five, and Kala (or Jiva), the effects of past acts, and Ignorance,-these eight eternal essences are the causes of the birth and destruction of creatures.

sa: सत्येन चाग्निर्दहति स्वर्गः सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितः। सत्यं यज्ञस्तपो वेदाः स्तोभा मन्त्राः सरस्वती॥
en: It is by truth that Fire burns. It is on truth that Heaven rests. Truth is Sacrifice. Penance, Vedas, the verses of Samans, Mantras, and Sarasvati.
